papers.title: Semi-quantitative ultrasound scoring reveals hepatic structural recovery and immune modulation during tenofovir alafenamide therapy in chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: Objective This study aimed to evaluate the therapeutic response to tenofovir alafenamide fumarate (TAF) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) using a semi-quantitative ultrasound (US) scoring system, and to investigate the correlation between sonographic changes and immune function restoration. Methods A total of 100 CHB patients who received TAF monotherapy (25 mg/day) for at least 24 months were retrospectively enrolled. A seven-parameter semi-quantitative US score, encompassing liver echogenicity, capsular contour, margin shape, vessel clarity, portal vein diameter (PVD), spleen thickness (ST), and splenic vein velocity (SVV), was calculated at baseline, 12 months, and 24 months. Concurrently, serum hepatitis B virus (HBV) deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), peripheral T-cell subsets, including cluster of differentiation 3-positive (CD3 + ), CD4 + , CD8 + T cells, CD4+/CD8+ ratio, and natural killer (NK) cell activity were measured. Correlations between US scores and biochemical/immune parameters were analyzed. Results At 24 months, all patients achieved HBV DNA <20 IU/mL, with ALT and AST normalization rates of 92% and 95%, respectively. The comprehensive US score decreased significantly from 7.86 ± 1.73 at baseline to 3.37 ± 0.95 at 24 months ( P < 0.001), with the most pronounced improvements observed in capsular smoothness and parenchymal homogeneity. The CD4 + T-cell proportion and CD4 + /CD8 + ratio increased, whereas the CD8 + proportion decreased; NK cell activity rose from 42.7 ± 7.3% to 52.4 ± 6.2% ( P < 0.05). The US score was positively correlated with ALT (r = 0.56) and AST (r = 0.47), and negatively correlated with the CD4 + /CD8 + ratio (r = −0.46) and NK cell activity (r = −0.38) (all P < 0.01). Conclusion These findings indicate that TAF not only suppresses viral replication and normalises liver enzymes but also promotes measurable structural liver improvement, as reflected by declining semi-quantitative US scores. The strong correlations of US scores with biochemical and immune parameters support its utility as a non-invasive imaging biomarker for monitoring treatment efficacy and hepatic repair.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the therapeutic response to tenofovir alafenamide fumarate (TAF) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) using a semi-quantitative ultrasound (US) scoring system. It aimed to assess the correlation between sonographic changes and immune function restoration. A total of 100 CHB patients on TAF monotherapy for at least 24 months were enrolled. The US score, which included seven parameters, was calculated at baseline, 12 months, and 24 months. Serum HBV DNA, ALT, AST, and immune parameters were also measured. At 24 months, all patients achieved HBV DNA <20 IU/mL, with ALT and AST normalization rates of 92% and 95%, respectively. The US score significantly decreased, indicating structural liver improvement. The US score correlated positively with ALT and AST and negatively with CD4+/CD8+ ratio and NK cell activity. These findings suggest that TAF not only suppresses viral replication and normalizes liver enzymes but also promotes measurable structural liver improvement. The strong correlations support the use of US as a non-invasive biomarker for monitoring treatment efficacy and hepatic repair. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the absence of reported limitations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在利用半定量超声(US)评分系统评估替诺福韦艾拉酚胺二甲基磺酸盐(TAF)在慢性乙型肝炎(慢性乙型肝炎)患者中的治疗反应,并探讨超声影像变化与免疫功能恢复之间的相关性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 回顾性纳入 100 名接受 TAF 单药治疗(25 毫克/天)至少 24 个月的慢性乙型肝炎患者。
elements_zh.methods: 在基线、12 个月和 24 个月时计算七参数半定量 US 评分,包括肝脏回声性、包膜轮廓、边缘形状、血管清晰度、门静脉直径 (PVD)、脾厚度 (ST) 和脾静脉速度 (SVV)。同时,测量血清 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 脱氧核糖核酸 (DNA)、丙氨酸转氨酶 (ALT)、天冬氨酸转氨酶 (AST)、外周 T 细胞亚群,包括分化簇 3 阳性 (CD3 + )、CD4 + 、CD8 + T 细胞、CD4 + / CD8 + 比率和自然杀伤 (NK) 细胞活性。
elements_zh.main_results: 在24个月时,所有患者均达到HBV DNA <20 IU/mL,ALT和AST的正常化率分别为92%和95%。综合超声评分从基线的7.86 ± 1.73显著下降至24个月的3.37 ± 0.95(P < 0.001),其中包膜平滑度和实质均匀性的改善最为显著。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 分析了美国评分与生化/免疫参数之间的相关性。US评分与ALT(r = 0.56)和AST(r = 0.47)呈正相关,与CD4 + /CD8 + 比值(r = -0.46)和NK细胞活性(r = -0.38)呈负相关(均P < 0.01)。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 超声评分与生化和免疫参数之间的强相关性支持其作为非侵入性影像生物标志物用于监测治疗疗效和肝脏修复的潜力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告局限性。

papers.title_zh: 半定量超声评分揭示慢性乙型肝炎(慢性乙型肝炎)在接受替诺福韦艾拉酚胺治疗期间肝脏结构恢复和免疫调节
papers.source_body_en: Objective This study aimed to evaluate the therapeutic response to tenofovir alafenamide fumarate (TAF) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) using a semi-quantitative ultrasound (US) scoring system, and to investigate the correlation between sonographic changes and immune function restoration. Methods A total of 100 CHB patients who received TAF monotherapy (25 mg/day) for at least 24 months were retrospectively enrolled. A seven-parameter semi-quantitative US score, encompassing liver echogenicity, capsular contour, margin shape, vessel clarity, portal vein diameter (PVD), spleen thickness (ST), and splenic vein velocity (SVV), was calculated at baseline, 12 months, and 24 months. Concurrently, serum hepatitis B virus (HBV) deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), peripheral T-cell subsets, including cluster of differentiation 3-positive (CD3 + ), CD4 + , CD8 + T cells, CD4+/CD8+ ratio, and natural killer (NK) cell activity were measured. Correlations between US scores and biochemical/immune parameters were analyzed. Results At 24 months, all patients achieved HBV DNA <20 IU/mL, with ALT and AST normalization rates of 92% and 95%, respectively. The comprehensive US score decreased significantly from 7.86 ± 1.73 at baseline to 3.37 ± 0.95 at 24 months ( P < 0.001), with the most pronounced improvements observed in capsular smoothness and parenchymal homogeneity. The CD4 + T-cell proportion and CD4 + /CD8 + ratio increased, whereas the CD8 + proportion decreased; NK cell activity rose from 42.7 ± 7.3% to 52.4 ± 6.2% ( P < 0.05). The US score was positively correlated with ALT (r = 0.56) and AST (r = 0.47), and negatively correlated with the CD4 + /CD8 + ratio (r = −0.46) and NK cell activity (r = −0.38) (all P < 0.01). Conclusion These findings indicate that TAF not only suppresses viral replication and normalises liver enzymes but also promotes measurable structural liver improvement, as reflected by declining semi-quantitative US scores. The strong correlations of US scores with biochemical and immune parameters support its utility as a non-invasive imaging biomarker for monitoring treatment efficacy and hepatic repair.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在利用半定量超声(US)评分系统评估替诺福韦艾拉酚胺二甲基磺酸盐(TAF)在慢性乙型肝炎(慢性乙型肝炎)患者中的治疗反应,并探讨超声影像变化与免疫功能恢复之间的相关性。方法 入选了100例接受TAF单药治疗(25 mg/天)至少24个月的慢性乙型肝炎患者进行回顾性分析。在基线、12个月和24个月时计算了包含肝脏回声、包膜轮廓、边缘形态、血管清晰度、门静脉直径(PVD)、脾脏厚度(ST)和脾静脉血流速度(SVV)的七参数半定量超声评分。同时测量了血清乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)脱氧核糖核酸(DNA)、丙氨酸氨基转移酶(ALT)、天门冬氨酸氨基转移酶(AST)以及外周T细胞亚群,包括分化簇3阳性(CD3+)、CD4+、CD8+ T细胞、CD4+/CD8+比值和自然杀伤(NK)细胞活性。分析了超声评分与生化和免疫参数之间的相关性。结果 在24个月时,所有患者均达到HBV DNA <20 IU/mL,ALT和AST的正常化率分别为92%和95%。综合超声评分从基线的7.86 ± 1.73显著下降至24个月的3.37 ± 0.95(P < 0.001),其中包膜平滑度和实质均匀性的改善最为显著。CD4+ T细胞比例和CD4+/CD8+比值增加,而CD8+ T细胞比例下降;NK细胞活性从42.7 ± 7.3%上升至52.4 ± 6.2%(P < 0.05)。超声评分与ALT(r = 0.56)和AST(r = 0.47)呈正相关,与CD4+/CD8+比值(r = −0.46)和NK细胞活性(r = −0.38)呈负相关(所有P < 0.01)。结论 这些发现表明,TAF不仅抑制病毒复制并使肝酶正常化,还促进可测量的肝脏结构改善,这体现在半定量超声评分的下降。超声评分与生化和免疫参数之间的强相关性支持其作为非侵入性影像生物标志物用于监测治疗疗效和肝脏修复的潜力。

papers.title: Testing for hepatitis C virus and hepatitis B virus/hepatitis D virus: Current scenarios and perspectives in Italy
papers.abstract: Liver disease accounts for approximately 4% of all deaths worldwide, and viral hepatitis affects more than 300 million people. The World Health Organization aims to reduce new hepatitis infections by 90% and deaths by 65% by 2030 through vaccination and screening programs. In Italy, screening for hepatitis C virus (HCV) benefits from dedicated government funding, whereas testing for hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis D virus (HDV) is supported by recommendations from scientific societies but does not benefit from dedicated national public health programmes. This expert-opinion review summarises the experience of tertiary-level Italian centres actively engaged in hospital-based testing for HCV, HBV, and HDV and identifies practical pathways to improve testing and linkage to care. This article presents proposals to improve the effectiveness of viral hepatitis management in Italy by: (1) Strengthening coordination between hospital units and integrating information systems between general practitioners and hospitals; (2) Implementing a centralised reporting system and a structured referral network to ensure that patients with positive test results receive appropriate therapies in a timely manner; (3) Providing the resources needed to increase testing in public addiction treatment services (Servizi per le Dipendenze) and prisons; (4) Promoting screening in high-risk populations, including vulnerable and older populations; and (5) Implementing a national awareness campaign on viral hepatitis. These measures could help Italy make concrete progress towards eliminating HCV infection and controlling HBV/HDV infection within the next decade.

papers.title: Selection, escape and the limits of inference in Middle Eastern hepatitis B virus genotype D: an analysis of 824 curated public sequences
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Hepatitis B virus genotype D (HBV/D) predominates across the Middle East, yet questions asked of its public sequence archive are rarely preceded by a test of whether that archive can answer them. Methods HBV records of 500–4,000 nt from fifteen Middle Eastern countries were retrieved from GenBank, genotype assigned against a 98-genome A–H reference panel, and records filtered on collection date, surface-gene coverage, ambiguity and within-country identity. Curated sequences were projected onto a genotype D reference (LC519816.1), giving a reference-anchored matrix across the surface and reverse-transcriptase frames. A maximum-likelihood tree was inferred under GTR+Γ, temporal signal tested by root-to-tip regression, and ancestral country states reconstructed under a discrete migration model and re-estimated on five country-balanced subsamples. Results Of 4,398 records retrieved, 824 sequences from ten countries passed curation (Iraq, 94). Canonical resistance substitutions (rtL180M, rtM204V/I, rtV173L) and surface escape substitutions (sP120S/T, sS143L, sD144A/E/G, sG145R/A) were recovered, with rtL180M and rtM204V/I most frequent (each >2%) the compensatory and escape substitutions each below 2%, as in clinical series of treated genotype D infection. Twelve codons showed diversifying selection by two methods, only one inside a determinant and none at classical escape positions; antigenic-loop selection did not differ from the rest of the protein (Mann-Whitney p = 0.50; permutation p = 0.61). Four planned analyses failed: root-to-tip regression gave R2 = 0.002, so the dataset cannot be dated; the apparent Iranian source signal (+200 net exports) fell to +1.2 under balanced subsampling, where Syria (+27.0) displaced Iran; median pairwise distance was 0.0128 substitutions/site, with 97.0% of sequences in one component at 0.015; and subgenotype assignment left only 7.2% of sequences resolvable at a 0.005 margin. Conclusions Substantively, the HBsAg antigenic loop shows no excess of diversifying selection despite immune surveillance, and monitored escape positions carry no site-level signature, consistent with escape arising as rare individually selected events rather than a selective regime. Methodologically, the archive supports mutational and selection epidemiology but not dating, source attribution, transmission clustering or subgenotype assignment from surface-gene data; the constraint is sequence length and sampling design, not sample size.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the public sequence archive of hepatitis B virus genotype D to determine if it could support inferences about selection and escape mechanisms in the Middle East. The background highlighted that HBV/D is prevalent in the region, but its sequence archive has not been rigorously tested for its ability to answer specific questions.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed 824 curated public sequences from ten Middle Eastern countries, including Iraq, to explore patterns of diversifying selection and escape substitutions. These sequences were sourced from GenBank and filtered based on collection date, surface-gene coverage, ambiguity, and within-country identity.
analysis.methods: The sequences were projected onto a genotype D reference, and a maximum-likelihood tree was inferred under GTR+Γ. Temporal signal was tested via root-to-tip regression, and ancestral country states were reconstructed using a discrete migration model, re-estimated on five country-balanced subsamples.
analysis.main_results: Of 4,398 retrieved records, 824 sequences from ten countries passed curation. Canonical resistance substitutions (rtL180M, rtM204V/I) and surface escape substitutions (sP120S/T, sS143L, sD144A/E/G, sG145R/A) were identified, with rtL180M and rtM204V/I being the most frequent (>2%). Twelve codons showed diversifying selection, but none were within classical escape positions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that the HBsAg antigenic loop does not show an excess of diversifying selection, and escape positions lack site-level signatures, suggesting escape arises from rare individually selected events rather than a consistent selective regime. This finding is novel as it challenges assumptions about immune-driven selection in HBV/D.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the understanding of immune-driven evolution in HBV/D and highlight the limitations of using surface-gene data for source attribution or transmission clustering. This has implications for improving surveillance and diagnostic strategies for genotype D hepatitis B.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The dataset lacks temporal signal and cannot be dated, and subgenotype assignment is limited due to sequence length and sampling design. Despite these limitations, the evidence is moderate, as the study provides a detailed analysis of curated sequences and their evolutionary patterns.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查 乙型肝炎病毒 D 基因型的公共序列档案,以确定它是否可以支持有关中东选择和逃逸机制的推论。背景强调了 HBV/D 在该地区流行,但其序列档案尚未经过严格测试其回答特定问题的能力。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了来自包括伊拉克在内的十个中东国家的 824 个精心策划的公共序列,以探索多样化选择和逃避替代的模式。这些序列源自 GenBank,并根据收集日期、表面基因覆盖度、模糊性和国内身份进行过滤。
elements_zh.methods: 将序列投影到基因型 D 参考上,并在 GTR+Γ 下推断最大似然树。通过从根到尖的回归测试时间信号,并使用离散迁移模型重建祖先国家,并在五个国家平衡子样本上重新估计。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 4,398 个检索记录中,来自 10 个国家的 824 个序列通过了管理。确定了规范耐药替代(rtL180M、rtM204V/I)和表面逃逸替代(sP120S/T、sS143L、sD144A/E/G、sG145R/A),其中 rtL180M 和 rtM204V/I 最常见(>2%)。十二个密码子显示出多样化的选择,但没有一个位于经典的逃逸位置内。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,HBsAg 抗原环没有表现出过度的多样化选择,并且逃逸位置缺乏位点水平的特征,这表明逃逸源于罕见的单独选择事件,而不是一致的选择机制。这一发现是新颖的,因为它挑战了 HBV/D 中免疫驱动选择的假设。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现有助于理解 HBV/D 中免疫驱动的 进化,并强调使用表面基因数据进行来源归因或 传播 聚类的局限性。这对于改进 监测 和 D 基因型乙型肝炎的诊断策略具有重要意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 数据集缺乏时间信号并且无法确定日期,并且由于序列长度和采样设计,亚基因型分配受到限制。尽管存在这些局限性,但证据并不充分,因为该研究提供了对策划序列及其进化模式的详细分析。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 乙型肝炎病毒 基因型 D (HBV/D) 在整个中东地区占主导地位,但在对其公共序列档案提出问题之前很少先测试该档案是否能够回答这些问题。方法 从 GenBank 检索来自 15 个中东国家的 500-4,000 nt HBV 记录,根据 98-基因组 A-H 参考组分配基因型,并根据收集日期、表面基因覆盖度、模糊性和国内身份过滤记录。将策划的序列投影到基因型 D 参考 (LC519816.1) 上,从而在表面和反转录酶框架上提供参考锚定矩阵。在 GTR+Γ 下推断最大似然树,通过根到尖回归测试时间信号,在离散迁移模型下重建祖先国家,并在五个国家平衡子样本上重新估计。结果 在检索到的 4,398 条记录中,来自 10 个国家的 824 条序列通过了管理(伊拉克,94 条)。恢复了规范抗性替换(rtL180M、rtM204V/I、rtV173L)和表面逃逸替换(sP120S/T、sS143L、sD144A/E/G、sG145R/A),其中 rtL180M 和 rtM204V/I 最常见(每个 >2%),补偿和逃逸替换如下2%,如治疗 D 基因型感染的临床系列。十二个密码子通过两种方法表现出多样化选择,只有一个在决定簇内,没有一个在经典逃逸位置;抗原环选择与蛋白质的其余部分没有差异(Mann-Whitney p = 0.50;排列 p = 0.61)。四个计划分析失败:从根到尖回归得出 R2 = 0.002,因此无法确定数据集的日期;在平衡二次抽样下,明显的伊朗源信号(+200 净出口)降至+1.2,其中叙利亚(+27.0)取代了伊朗;中位成对距离为 0.0128 个取代/位点,其中一个组件中 97.0% 的序列为 0.015;亚基因型分配仅留下 7.2% 的序列可在 0.005 的裕度下解析。结论 实质上,尽管有免疫 监测,HBsAg 抗原环并未表现出过度的多样化选择,并且监测的逃逸位置不携带位点水平特征,这与逃逸作为罕见的单独选择事件而不是选择性机制一致。从方法上讲,该档案支持突变和选择 传播,但不支持约会、来源归因、传播 聚类或表面基因数据的亚基因型分配;约束是序列长度和抽样设计,而不是样本大小。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查 乙型肝炎病毒 D 基因型的公共序列档案,以确定它是否可以支持有关中东选择和逃逸机制的推论。背景强调了 HBV/D 在该地区流行,但其序列档案尚未经过严格测试其回答特定问题的能力。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了来自包括伊拉克在内的十个中东国家的 824 个精心策划的公共序列,以探索多样化选择和逃避替代的模式。这些序列源自 GenBank,并根据收集日期、表面基因覆盖度、模糊性和国内身份进行过滤。
analysis_zh.methods: 将序列投影到基因型 D 参考上,并在 GTR+Γ 下推断最大似然树。通过从根到尖的回归测试时间信号,并使用离散迁移模型重建祖先国家,并在五个国家平衡子样本上重新估计。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在 4,398 个检索记录中,来自 10 个国家的 824 个序列通过了管理。确定了规范耐药替代(rtL180M、rtM204V/I)和表面逃逸替代(sP120S/T、sS143L、sD144A/E/G、sG145R/A),其中 rtL180M 和 rtM204V/I 最常见(>2%)。十二个密码子显示出多样化的选择,但没有一个位于经典的逃逸位置内。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,HBsAg 抗原环没有表现出过度的多样化选择,并且逃逸位置缺乏位点水平的特征,这表明逃逸源于罕见的单独选择事件,而不是一致的选择机制。这一发现是新颖的,因为它挑战了 HBV/D 中免疫驱动选择的假设。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现有助于理解 HBV/D 中免疫驱动的 进化,并强调使用表面基因数据进行来源归因或 传播 聚类的局限性。这对于改进 监测 和 D 基因型乙型肝炎的诊断策略具有重要意义。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 数据集缺乏时间信号并且无法确定日期,并且由于序列长度和采样设计,亚基因型分配受到限制。尽管存在这些局限性,但证据并不充分,因为该研究提供了对策划序列及其进化模式的详细分析。

papers.title: Prevalence of hepatitis B surface antigen and hepatitis B core antibodies among pregnant women in Yemen
papers.abstract: Background: Hepatitis B infection is a public health concern worldwide. It is associated with high rates of mother-tochild transmission, yet there are no published studies on the infection among pregnant women in the southern and eastern governorates of Yemen. Aim: To assess the prevalence of hepatitis B infection among pregnant women attending primary health care centres in Yemen. Methods: Between December 2023 and February 2024, we interviewed and tested 921 pregnant Yemeni women attending primary health care centres for antenatal care services in Aden, Mukalla and Marib governorates of Yemen. We analysed the data using SPSS version 25 and used chi-square to test the association between the categorical variables. P = 0.05 was taken as statistical significance. Results: Forty-five of the 921 pregnant women (5%) were reactive for HBsAg (95% CI; 3.6–6.5%) and 66 (7.2%) for (95% CI; 5.6%-9%). Marib Governorate had the highest prevalence of HBsAg (10.4%) and anti-HBc (12.7%). Type of governorate and social status of the women were significantly associated with HBsAg and anti-HBc reactivity. First trimester was associated with HBsAg. Conclusion: The moderate prevalence of hepatitis B among pregnant women in Yemen increases the risk of motherto-child transmission and a high-risk of chronic hepatitis in infected children. It indicates the need for preventive interventions, including routine screening of pregnant women and introduction of birth dose hepatitis B vaccine.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to assess the prevalence of hepatitis B infection among pregnant women in Yemen, focusing on the southern and eastern governorates. Between December 2023 and February 2024, 921 pregnant women were interviewed and tested at primary health care centres in Aden, Mukalla, and Marib. papers.title: Community-Based Detection of Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, and Herpes Simplex Viruses in Northern Thailand
papers.abstract: Blood-borne viral infections remain important public health concerns worldwide. Hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) are well-established transfusion-transmissible pathogens, whereas the epidemiological significance of detecting herpes simplex virus (HSV) DNA in peripheral blood remains unclear. This cross-sectional study investigated HBsAg, anti-HCV antibodies, and HSV-1/HSV-2 DNA in a community-based population in northern Thailand. Serum samples from 779 participants were tested for HBsAg and anti-HCV using rapid immunochromatographic assays, while whole-blood samples from 639 participants were tested for HSV-1 and HSV-2 DNA using real-time PCR. HBsAg and anti-HCV were detected in 3.0% (23/779) and 1.8% (14/779) of participants, respectively. HSV-1 and HSV-2 DNA were each detected in 0.5% (3/639) of whole-blood samples. In the regression analysis, higher body weight was associated with lower odds of HBsAg detection (AOR = 0.955, 95% CI: 0.929–0.982; p = 0.001). These findings provide updated community-based epidemiological data on HBV, HCV, and HSV in northern Thailand. Because HSV DNA was detected infrequently and sequence confirmation was limited, the HSV findings should be interpreted with caution. Further studies involving larger populations, quantitative viral-load measurements, and longitudinal sampling are needed.

papers.title: Serum platelet-derived growth factor-BB as a noninvasive biomarker of significant liver fibrosis in patients with chronic hepatitis B: a cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) is a major cause of progressive liver fibrosis (LF), cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Although noninvasive fibrosis assessment is essential, current tools have practical and diagnostic limitations. Platelet-derived growth factor-BB (PDGF-BB)—a profibrogenic mediator of hepatic stellate cell activation—may be a biologically relevant fibrosis biomarker. This study examined the ability of serum PDGF-BB to detect significant fibrosis in CHB patients which is defined as liver stiffness > 7 kPa by vibration-controlled transient elastography (VCTE; FibroScan). Methods This cross-sectional exploratory diagnostic accuracy study included 90 treatment-naive adults with CHB attending Tanta University Hospitals and Kafr El-Sheikh University Hospitals. All participants underwent clinical evaluation; routine laboratory testing, including HBsAg, HBeAg, and serum HBV DNA; abdominal ultrasonography; serum PDGF-BB measurement by ELISA; and FibroScan examination. VCTE-defined significant fibrosis (F2–F4) was set as liver stiffness > 7 kPa. A non-randomized convenience sampling approach was used to enroll participants, and the optimal PDGF-BB cutoff was established based on the ROC curve derived from this cohort. Results Among 90 patients, 69 (76.7%) had F0-F1 fibrosis and 21 (23.3%) had F2-F4 fibrosis. HBeAg was positive in 21.1% of patients and median HBV DNA was 4.47 (3.68–5.31) log10 IU/mL Median serum PDGF-BB was significantly increased in patients with F2-F4 than in those with F0-F1 fibrosis: 2500.8 (2028.25-2721.8) vs. 777.13 (479.21-1743.15) pg/mL, respectively ( p < 0.001). Serum PDGF-BB discriminated VCTE-defined significant fibrosis at an exploratory, internally derived cutoff of ≥ 1885.9 pg/mL, with an AUC of 0.905 (95% CI 0.816–0.994), sensitivity of 85.7%, specificity of 84.1%, positive predictive value of 62.1%, negative predictive value of 95.1% (at the 23.3% prevalence of this cohort), and overall accuracy of 84.4% (Youden index 0.698; p < 0.001). PDGF-BB had a numerically higher AUC than APRI (0.717) and GPR (0.715), but these differences did not reach statistical significance after Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons. It did not differ significantly from FIB-4 (0.780) and did not outperform platelet count (0.980) or INR (0.931). Conclusions Serum PDGF-BB demonstrated good discrimination for VCTE-defined significant fibrosis in treatment-naive patients with CHB. Its negative predictive value of 95%, though prevalence-dependent, suggests potential utility as a triage or adjunctive biomarker. However, these findings are preliminary and require external validation before clinical implementation or substitution for elastography.

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 这些发现是初步的,在临床实施或替代弹性成像之前需要外部验证。该研究使用了非随机方便抽样方法,这可能会限制普遍性。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 是进行性肝纤维化 (LF)、肝硬化和肝细胞癌的主要原因。尽管无创纤维化评估至关重要,但目前的工具具有实用和诊断局限性。血小板源性生长因子-BB (PDGF-BB)——一种肝星状细胞活化的促纤维化介质——可能是一种生物学相关的纤维化生物标志物。本研究检查了血清 PDGF-BB 检测慢性乙型肝炎患者显着纤维化的能力,慢性乙型肝炎患者的纤维化定义为通过振动控制瞬时弹性成像(VCTE;FibroScan)肝脏硬度 > 7 kPa。方法 这项横断面探索性诊断准确性研究包括 90 名在坦塔大学医院和 Kafr El-Sheikh 大学医院就诊的 90 名患有 治疗 的慢性乙型肝炎成人。所有参与者均接受临床评估;常规实验室检测,包括 HBsAg、HBeAg 和血清 HBV DNA;腹部超声检查;ELISA测定血清PDGF-BB;和 FibroScan 检查。VCTE 定义的显着纤维化 (F2–F4) 被设置为肝脏硬度 > 7 kPa。使用非随机方便抽样方法来招募参与者,并根据从该 队列研究 得出的 ROC 曲线建立最佳 PDGF-BB 截止值。结果 90例患者中,F0-F1期纤维化69例(76.7%),F2-F4期纤维化21例(23.3%)。21.1% 的患者 HBeAg 呈阳性,中位 HBV DNA 为 4.47 (3.68–5.31) log10 IU/mL F2-F4 患者血清 PDGF-BB 中位值显着高于 F0-F1 纤维化患者:2500.8 (2028.25-2721.8) vs. 777.13分别为 (479.21-1743.15) pg/mL (p < 0.001)。血清 PDGF-BB 以 ≥ 1885.9 pg/mL 的探索性内部衍生临界值区分 VCTE 定义的显着纤维化,AUC 为 0.905 (95% CI 0.816–0.994),敏感性为 85.7%,特异性为 84.1%,阳性预测值为 62.1%,阴性预测值为 95.1%(在23.3% 患病率 of this 队列研究),总体准确度为 84.4%(Youden 指数 0.698;p < 0.001)。PDGF-BB的AUC在数值上高于APRI(0.717)和GPR(0.715),但在多重比较的Bonferroni校正后这些差异并未达到统计学显着性。它与 FIB-4 (0.780) 没有显着差异,并且没有优于血小板计数 (0.980) 或 INR (0.931)。结论 血清 PDGF-BB 对 治疗 初治 CHB 患者中 VCTE 定义的显着纤维化表现出良好的辨别力。尽管与 患病率 相关,但其阴性预测值为 95%,表明作为分类或辅助生物标志物的潜在实用性。然而,这些发现是初步的,在临床实施或替代弹性成像之前需要外部验证。

papers.title: Gut microbial characteristics associated with pegylated interferon treatment response in chronic hepatitis B: insights into the gut–liver axis
papers.abstract: Background Pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) treatment response varies considerably among patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). The role of the gut microbiota in this heterogeneity remains unclear. This study aimed to characterize gut microbial features associated with Peg-IFN response and explore their potential relevance to the gut–liver axis. Methods A total of 64 patients with CHB who completed 24 weeks of Peg-IFN-based therapy were enrolled in this study. Fecal samples collected at week 24 were analyzed using 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Microbial characteristics and clinical factors associated with treatment response were evaluated, followed by development of an integrated classification model. Results Among the 64 patients, 38 were classified as responders and 26 as non-responders. Responders exhibited distinct gut microbial profiles, characterized by increased microbial richness ( p = 0.014), altered community composition ( p = 0.045), and different microbial interaction patterns. Dorea abundance was enriched in responders and independently associated with treatment response. Multivariable logistic regression identified lower baseline HBsAg levels (OR = 0.562, p = 0.048), higher platelet counts (OR = 1.020, p = 0.007), and increased Dorea abundance (OR = 3.876, p = 0.008) as independent factors associated with response. Restricted cubic spline analysis supported a significant association between Dorea abundance and response probability. The Virological–Host–Microbial (VHM) triad model integrating these factors demonstrated promising apparent discrimination (ROC-AUC = 0.790) and calibration in the development cohort. Conclusion Distinct gut microbial ecological patterns are associated with Peg-IFN treatment response in CHB, with Dorea representing a characteristic microbial feature. This study provides a multidimensional framework for understanding heterogeneity in interferon responsiveness and highlights the potential relevance of the gut–liver–immune axis.

papers.title_zh: 与 慢性乙型肝炎 中聚乙二醇化干扰素 治疗 反应相关的肠道微生物特征:对肠-肝轴的见解
papers.source_body_en: Background Pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) treatment response varies considerably among patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). The role of the gut microbiota in this heterogeneity remains unclear. This study aimed to characterize gut microbial features associated with Peg-IFN response and explore their potential relevance to the gut–liver axis. Methods A total of 64 patients with CHB who completed 24 weeks of Peg-IFN-based therapy were enrolled in this study. Fecal samples collected at week 24 were analyzed using 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Microbial characteristics and clinical factors associated with treatment response were evaluated, followed by development of an integrated classification model. Results Among the 64 patients, 38 were classified as responders and 26 as non-responders. Responders exhibited distinct gut microbial profiles, characterized by increased microbial richness ( p = 0.014), altered community composition ( p = 0.045), and different microbial interaction patterns. Dorea abundance was enriched in responders and independently associated with treatment response. Multivariable logistic regression identified lower baseline HBsAg levels (OR = 0.562, p = 0.048), higher platelet counts (OR = 1.020, p = 0.007), and increased Dorea abundance (OR = 3.876, p = 0.008) as independent factors associated with response. Restricted cubic spline analysis supported a significant association between Dorea abundance and response probability. The Virological–Host–Microbial (VHM) triad model integrating these factors demonstrated promising apparent discrimination (ROC-AUC = 0.790) and calibration in the development cohort. Conclusion Distinct gut microbial ecological patterns are associated with Peg-IFN treatment response in CHB, with Dorea representing a characteristic microbial feature. This study provides a multidimensional framework for understanding heterogeneity in interferon responsiveness and highlights the potential relevance of the gut–liver–immune axis.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 聚乙二醇化干扰素 (Peg-IFN) 治疗 的反应在 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者中差异很大。肠道微生物群在这种异质性中的作用仍不清楚。本研究旨在表征与 Peg-IFN 反应相关的肠道微生物特征,并探讨它们与肠-肝轴的潜在相关性。方法 共有 64 例完成 24 周 Peg-IFN 治疗的慢性乙型肝炎患者纳入本研究。使用 16S rRNA 基因测序对第 24 周收集的粪便样本进行分析。评估了与 治疗 反应相关的微生物特征和临床因素,然后开发了综合分类模型。结果 64 例患者中,38 例为有反应者,26 例为无反应者。应答者表现出独特的肠道微生物特征,其特征是微生物丰富度增加(p = 0.014)、群落组成改变(p = 0.045)和不同的微生物相互作用模式。Dorea 丰度在应答者中丰富,并且与 治疗 应答独立相关。多变量逻辑回归确定较低的基线 HBsAg 水平(OR = 0.562,p = 0.048)、较高的血小板计数(OR = 1.020,p = 0.007)和增加的 Dorea 丰度(OR = 3.876,p = 0.008)作为与缓解相关的独立因素。受限三次样条分析支持 Dorea 丰度与响应概率之间的显着关联。整合这些因素的病毒学-宿主-微生物 (VHM) 三联体模型在 队列研究 的开发中证明了有希望的明显区分 (ROC-AUC = 0.790) 和校准。结论 不同的肠道微生物生态模式与 CHB 中的 Peg-IFN 治疗 反应相关,其中 Dorea 代表了一种典型的微生物特征。这项研究为理解干扰素反应的异质性提供了一个多维框架,并强调了肠-肝-免疫轴的潜在相关性。

papers.title: Distinct plasma proteomic trajectories during PD-1 blockade and PEG-IFNα therapy are associated with HBsAg response in chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: Background PD-1 blockade and pegylated interferon-α (PEG-IFNα) are promising immunomodulatory strategies for chronic hepatitis B (CHB), but their systemic immune effects and response-associated proteomic patterns remain poorly defined. Methods We performed longitudinal plasma proteomic profiling using the Olink Target 96 Inflammation panel in 25 nucleos(t)ide analogue-suppressed patients with CHB receiving PD-1 blockade (n=10) or PEG-IFNα (n=15). Plasma samples were collected at baseline, week 12, and week 24. Longitudinal protein changes were analyzed using linear mixed-effects models, and associations with week-24 HBsAg decline were evaluated using responder–non-responder comparisons and Spearman’s rank correlation. Responders were defined by an HBsAg decline of ≥1 log 10 IU/mL at week 24. Results Seventy-seven proteins passed quality-control criteria. PEG-IFNα induced substantially broader longitudinal proteomic remodeling than PD-1 blockade, with most changes occurring within the first 12 weeks. Treatment-by-time analyses identified distinct trajectories between therapies, including differential changes in IL-18R1, TNF, CX3CL1, CXCL9, and CXCL10. Response-associated analyses suggested treatment-specific patterns: IL-10 was the leading exploratory signal in the PD-1 cohort, whereas IL-12B, CDCP1, and FGF-21 were more prominent in the PEG-IFNα cohort. These response-related associations did not remain significant after false discovery rate correction and were therefore considered exploratory. Conclusions PD-1 blockade and PEG-IFNα induce distinct longitudinal circulating inflammatory proteomic programs in CHB. Favorable HBsAg decline was accompanied by treatment-specific rather than universal proteomic signatures, supporting the potential value of longitudinal proteomics for mechanistic and biomarker studies of HBV functional-cure strategies.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景 PD-1 阻断和聚乙二醇化干扰素-α (PEG-IFNα) 是 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 的有前途的免疫调节策略,但它们的全身免疫效应和反应相关的蛋白质组学模式仍不清楚。方法 我们使用 Olink Target 96 Inflammation panel 对 25 名接受 PD-1 阻断 (n=10) 或 PEG-IFNα (n=15) 的核苷(酸)类似物抑制的 CHB 患者进行了纵向血浆蛋白质组分析。在基线、第 12 周和第 24 周收集血浆样本。使用线性混合效应模型分析纵向蛋白质变化,并使用有反应者与无反应者比较和 Spearman 等级相关性评估与第 24 周 HBsAg 下降的关联。有反应者的定义是第 24 周时 HBsAg 下降≥1 log 10 IU/mL。结果 77 种蛋白质通过了质量控制标准。与 PD-1 阻断相比,PEG-IFNα 诱导了更广泛的纵向蛋白质组重塑,大多数变化发生在前 12 周内。治疗 按时间分析确定了治疗之间不同的轨迹,包括 IL-18R1、TNF、CX3CL1、CXCL9 和 CXCL10 的差异变化。响应相关分析表明 治疗 特异性模式:IL-10 是 PD-1 队列研究 中的主要探索信号,而 IL-12B、CDCP1 和 FGF-21 在 PEG-IFNα 队列研究 中更为突出。这些与反应相关的关联在错误发现率校正后并不仍然显着,因此被认为是探索性的。结论 PD-1 阻断和 PEG-IFNα 在 CHB 中诱导不同的纵向循环炎症蛋白质组程序。有利的 HBsAg 下降伴随着 治疗 特异性而非普遍的蛋白质组学特征,支持纵向蛋白质组学对于 HBV 功能治疗策略的机制和生物标志物研究的潜在价值。

papers.title: Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver and antiviral response in chronic hepatitis B: A systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) frequently coexists with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). However, its association with antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with CHB remains unclear. AIM To systematically evaluate the impact of MAFLD on antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with CHB. METHODS This systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines. PubMed, the Cochrane Library, EMBASE, and Web of Science were searched for studies published up to November 30, 2025. Meta-analyses were performed to assess associations between MAFLD and antiviral treatment responses or clinical outcomes. Subgroup analyses were conducted according to antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach, and leave-one-out sensitivity analyses were performed to evaluate robustness. RESULTS Thirty-two studies were included, of which 20 evaluated antiviral treatment efficacy and 13 assessed clinical outcomes in patients with CHB and concomitant MAFLD (one study reported both treatment responses and clinical outcomes). MAFLD was associated with a higher rate of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at 48 weeks [odds ratio (OR) = 1.41, 95%CI: 1.28-1.55], although this association was attenuated at 96 weeks (OR = 1.44, 95%CI: 0.96-2.16). No significant association was observed between MAFLD and hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance at any time-point. MAFLD was consistently associated with lower rates of alanine aminotransferase normalization and hepatitis B virus DNA clearance throughout the treatment duration. MAFLD was associated with a significantly increased risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) despite antiviral therapy (OR = 1.50, 95%CI: 1.01-2.24). Subgroup analyses according to the antiviral regimen revealed distinct patterns, partly explaining the heterogeneity in the overall analyses. Subgroup analyses suggested that the antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach partly explained the heterogeneity, particularly for hepatitis B virus DNA clearance and HCC. CONCLUSION MAFLD was associated with lower virological and biochemical response rates, higher odds of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at week 48, particularly among patients receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy, and higher odds of HCC in patients with CHB, but not with hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance. These findings support metabolic risk assessment in CHB management and highlight the need for standardized MAFLD/metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease definitions.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis investigates the association between metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) and antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). MAFLD was linked to lower virological and biochemical response rates, higher odds of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at week 48, and increased risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) despite antiviral therapy. elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述旨在评估 MAFLD 对 抗病毒药物 治疗 反应和 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者长期临床结果的影响。核心问题是 MAFLD 是否影响 CHB 患者对 抗病毒药物 治疗的病毒学、生化和临床反应。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本次系统评价和荟萃分析遵循 PRISMA 指南。证据基础包括来自 PubMed、Cochrane 图书馆、EMBASE 和 Web of Science 的截至 2025 年 11 月 30 日发表的研究。基于 抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法进行亚组分析,并进行留一敏感性分析以评估研究结果的稳健性。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: MAFLD 与较低的病毒学和生化反应率、第 48 周时乙型肝炎表面抗原血清清除的几率较高(特别是在接受核苷(酸)类似物治疗的患者中)以及尽管接受 抗病毒药物 治疗但发生肝细胞癌(HCC)的几率增加有关。然而,在任何时间点均未观察到 MAFLD 与乙型肝炎 e 抗原血清清除之间存在显着关联。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 亚组分析表明,抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法部分解释了总体结果的异质性,特别是 乙型肝炎病毒 DNA 清除率和 HCC 方面。证据没有报告 MAFLD 与这些结果相关的具体机制,也没有报告 MAFLD 对其他临床结果(如肝纤维化进展)的影响。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果支持将代谢风险评估纳入慢性乙型肝炎的管理,并强调需要对 MAFLD 和代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝病进行标准化定义。

papers.title: Prevalence of protective hepatitis B surface antibody levels and associated factors among women admitted for delivery at Kawempe National Referral Hospital, Uganda: A cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Mother-to-child transmission sustains the burden of hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in sub-Saharan Africa, yet little is known about whether women giving birth in Uganda are protected. We estimated the prevalence of protective hepatitis B surface antibody (anti-HBs) levels, described serological profiles and identified associated factors among women admitted for delivery at Kawempe National Referral Hospital, Kampala. In this cross-sectional study, 418 women were selected by systematic random sampling in 2024 and interviewed about socio-demographic characteristics, hepatitis B testing, vaccination and exposures. Anti-HBs was quantified by electrochemiluminescence immunoassay (protective: ≥10 mIU/mL); other HBV markers were screened with a rapid test. Prevalence ratios were estimated with modified Poisson regression. Overall, 264 women (63.2%) reported vaccination: 203 during the current pregnancy and 61 before it only. Protective levels were found in 322 women (77.0%; 95% confidence interval [CI] 72.8–80.8): 50.6% of never-vaccinated women, 82.0% of those vaccinated before the current pregnancy only and 95.6% of those vaccinated during it. After adjustment, vaccination before the current pregnancy only (adjusted prevalence ratio 1.54; 95% CI 1.24–1.89) and during it (1.86; 95% CI 1.57–2.20) were associated with protection; no socio-demographic or behavioural factor was. Eighty-two women (19.6%) had no serological evidence of immunity or infection; 65 had never been vaccinated. Of 300 women who reported a previous negative test, 50 (16.7%) had never been vaccinated, and 68 of 250 vaccinated women with known completion status (27.2%) had not completed three doses, mostly because they were not told to return or forgot. The rapid test detected hepatitis B surface antigen in 21 women (5.0%), but discordant marker patterns suggest some false positives. One in five women reached delivery susceptible to HBV, largely because a negative test was not followed by vaccination. Linking every negative antenatal test to vaccination could close much of this gap.

In this cross-sectional study, 418 women were selected by systematic random sampling in 2024 and interviewed about socio-demographic characteristics, hepatitis B testing, vaccination and exposures. Anti-HBs was quantified by electrochemiluminescence immunoassay (protective: ≥10 mIU/mL); other HBV markers were screened with a rapid test. Prevalence ratios were estimated with modified Poisson regression. Overall, 264 women (63.2%) reported vaccination: 203 during the current pregnancy and 61 before it only. Protective levels were found in 322 women (77.0%; 95% confidence interval [CI] 72.8–80.8): 50.6% of never-vaccinated women, 82.0% of those vaccinated before the current pregnancy only and 95.6% of those vaccinated during it. After adjustment, vaccination before the current pregnancy only (adjusted prevalence ratio 1.54; 95% CI 1.24–1.89) and during it (1.86; 95% CI 1.57–2.20) were associated with protection; no socio-demographic or behavioural factor was. Eighty-two women (19.6%) had no serological evidence of immunity or infection; 65 had never been vaccinated. Of 300 women who reported a previous negative test, 50 (16.7%) had never been vaccinated, and 68 of 250 vaccinated women with known completion status (27.2%) had not completed three doses, mostly because they were not told to return or forgot. The rapid test detected hepatitis B surface antigen in 21 women (5.0%), but discordant marker patterns suggest some false positives. One in five women reached delivery susceptible to HBV, largely because a negative test was not followed by vaccination. Linking every negative antenatal test to vaccination could close much of this gap.

The study found that 77.0% of the 418 participants had protective levels, with higher rates among those vaccinated during the current pregnancy compared to those vaccinated before. papers.title: Longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis with concurrent acute sensorimotor polyneuropathy secondary to hepatitis B virus reactivation: a case report
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) reactivation is a recognised complication of immunosuppressive therapy. Neurological complications from HBV reactivation are rare, particularly concurrent involvement of the central and peripheral nervous systems. We report a case of longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis (LETM) with concurrent acute sensorimotor polyneuropathy following HBV reactivation after rituximab containing chemotherapy for diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. A 58 year old man with a history of marginal zone lymphoma transformed to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) received rituximab based chemotherapy, with entecavir prescribed as antiviral prophylaxis because of previous HBV exposure. One month following cessation of chemotherapy, entecavir was discontinued. Six months later, he developed virologically confirmed HBV reactivation followed by acute progressive lower limb weakness, sensory disturbance, urinary retention and neuropathic pain. Neurological examination demonstrated bilateral lower limb weakness, areflexia, and a thoracic sensory level with impaired vibration and proprioception. Magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated a non-enhancing longitudinally extensive T2-hyperintense spinal cord lesion extending from C4 to T10, while nerve conduction studies demonstrated a sensorimotor polyneuropathy with axonal abnormalities and features suggestive of demyelination. Cerebrospinal fluid demonstrated mild protein elevation with pleocytosis, while extensive infectious, autoimmune and paraneoplastic investigations were unrevealing. Treatment with intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG), alongside continued antiviral therapy with entecavir, was followed by progressive neurological recovery, with complete radiological resolution of the spinal cord lesion and gradual functional improvement, although mild distal sensory deficits persisted. HBV reactivation may rarely present with concurrent LETM and acute sensorimotor polyneuropathy. In patients presenting with acute myeloneuropathy following rituximab containing chemotherapy, particularly after premature discontinuation of antiviral prophylaxis, HBV reactivation should be considered in the differential diagnosis. Early recognition and combined antiviral and immunomodulatory therapy may be associated with favourable neurological outcomes.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们报告了一例弥漫性大 B 细胞淋巴瘤接受含利妥昔单抗化疗后 HBV 再激活后出现纵向广泛横贯性脊髓炎 (LETM) 并并发急性感觉运动多发性神经病的病例。
elements_zh.methods: 该患者接受了基于利妥昔单抗的化疗,由于既往乙型肝炎病毒暴露,恩替卡韦作为 抗病毒药物 预防药物。化疗停止一个月后,恩替卡韦停药,六个月后,他出现病毒学证实的乙型肝炎病毒再激活。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: HBV 再激活很少会同时出现 LETM 和急性感觉运动性多发性神经病。对于接受含利妥昔单抗化疗后出现急性脊髓神经病的患者,特别是提前停止 抗病毒药物 预防后,在鉴别 诊断 时应考虑 HBV 再激活。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 早期识别以及联合 抗病毒药物 和免疫调节治疗可能与良好的神经学结果相关。

papers.abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 再激活是免疫抑制治疗公认的并发症。乙型肝炎病毒再激活引起的神经系统并发症很少见,特别是同时累及中枢和周围神经系统。我们报告了一例弥漫性大 B 细胞淋巴瘤接受含利妥昔单抗化疗后 HBV 再激活后出现纵向广泛横贯性脊髓炎 (LETM) 并并发急性感觉运动多发性神经病的病例。一名 58 岁男性,有边缘区淋巴瘤转化为弥漫性大 B 细胞淋巴瘤 (DLBCL) 的病史,接受了基于利妥昔单抗的化疗,并因既往 HBV 暴露而使用恩替卡韦作为 抗病毒药物 预防药物。停止化疗1个月后,恩替卡韦停药。六个月后,他出现病毒学证实的乙型肝炎病毒再激活,随后出现急性进行性下肢无力、感觉障碍、尿潴留和神经性疼痛。神经系统检查显示双侧下肢无力、反射消失、胸部感觉平面振动和本体感觉受损。磁共振成像显示从 C4 延伸至 T10 的非增强纵向广泛 T2 高信号脊髓病变,而神经传导研究显示感觉运动性多发性神经病,伴有轴突异常和提示脱髓鞘的特征。脑脊液显示轻度蛋白质升高并伴有细胞增多,而广泛的感染性、自身免疫性和副肿瘤性研究并未揭示这一点。治疗 静脉注射免疫球蛋白 (IVIG) 联合继续 抗病毒药物 恩替卡韦治疗后,神经功能逐渐恢复,脊髓病变完全放射学消退,功能逐渐改善,尽管轻度远端感觉缺陷仍然存在。HBV 再激活很少会同时出现 LETM 和急性感觉运动性多发性神经病。对于接受含利妥昔单抗化疗后出现急性脊髓神经病的患者,特别是提前停止 抗病毒药物 预防后,在鉴别 诊断 时应考虑 HBV 再激活。早期识别以及联合 抗病毒药物 和免疫调节治疗可能与良好的神经学结果相关。

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of glucocorticoid therapy for hepatitis B virus-related liver failure
papers.abstract: Objective To assess the clinical efficacy and safety of short-term glucocorticoid therapy in patients with early- or pre-stage hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related liver failure. Methods We retrospectively analyzed 143 patients with early- or pre-stage HBV-related liver failure treated at our center between January 2015 and December 2025. Of these, 43 received methylprednisolone conventional therapy (glucocorticoid group) and 100 received conventional therapy alone (conventional group). We analyzed the trends in total bilirubin (TBil), prothrombin time activity (PTA), and albumin (ALB) between the two groups during the initial 4 weeks, as well as 4-week clinical improvement, 12-week mortality, complications, and HBV-DNA changes. papers.title: Artificial intelligence-driven risk estimation, early detection, diagnostic characterisation and prognosis in hepatitis b-related hepatocellular carcinoma
papers.abstract: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains the leading global antecedent of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), yet the surveillance framework on which early detection depends is constrained at both of its load-bearing points: The modest sensitivity of biannual ultrasonography for early-stage tumours, and the bounded discrimination of risk scores that compress a nonlinear, time-evolving process into a small set of additively weighted covariates. Artificial intelligence (AI) has been advanced as a corrective, but the term is applied loosely and the supporting evidence is drawn from heterogeneous populations and from clinical tasks that are frequently conflated. This narrative review appraises AI across four separable tasks in the HBV-HCC pathway: Risk estimation in chronic hepatitis B, early detection during surveillance, diagnostic characterisation of established lesions, and prognosis after diagnosis. We state what is and is not counted as AI, describe the search strategy and selection principles, and categorise every cited study according to whether its evidence is HBV-specific, mixed-aetiology, hepatitis C virus-derived, drawn from general HCC populations, or confined to recurrence and prognosis. Where machine-learning models built on routine clinical variables have been compared with established scores within a single validation cohort, they have discriminated more accurately. Convolutional networks have improved ultrasonographic lesion detection, serological and cell-free DNA methylation models have been applied to early-stage detection beyond alpha-fetoprotein, and multi-omics integration has been used for molecular subclassification. These findings rest on a literature that is predominantly retrospective and single-centre, in which external validation is the exception, calibration is reported inconsistently, explainability is uneven, and meta-analysts repeatedly judge the underlying studies to be at high risk of bias. Evidence drawn specifically from hepatitis B cohorts remains a minority of the published work, and no study has demonstrated that an AI-guided strategy improves stage at diagnosis or survival. Prospective multicentre validation, transparent calibration, adherence to TRIPOD+AI and PROBAST+AI, and deliberate inclusion of African and South Asian populations are therefore prerequisites rather than refinements.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the role of artificial intelligence (AI) in addressing challenges in the surveillance, detection, and management of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) associated with hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection. It highlights the limitations of current methods, such as the modest sensitivity of ultrasonography and the bounded discrimination of risk scores. The review categorises studies based on their focus on HBV-specific evidence, mixed aetiologies, or other related viruses like hepatitis C. It finds that AI models, when compared to traditional scores within single validation cohorts, show improved discrimination. However, the evidence is largely retrospective and single-centre, with limited external validation and inconsistent calibration. The review concludes that AI strategies require prospective multicentre validation, transparent calibration, and inclusion of underrepresented populations to be effective in improving outcomes for HBV-related HCC.

elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 特别从乙型肝炎 队列研究 中提取的证据仍然是已发表作品的少数,并且没有研究表明人工智能引导的策略可以改善 诊断 的阶段或生存率。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 因此,前瞻性多中心验证、透明校准、遵守 TRIPOD+AI 和 PROBAST+AI 以及有意纳入非洲和南亚人群是先决条件,而不是改进。

papers.title: Time-Resolved Proteomic Analysis of Hepatitis B Virus Infection
papers.abstract: Abstract Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a major cause of chronic liver disease and hepatocellular carcinoma, yet its impact on host proteome dynamics during early infection remains poorly defined. Here, we performed time-resolved label-free quantitative (LFQ) proteomics to characterize the host response to HBV infection in human HepG2 hepatoma cells. Across five time points spanning the first 3 weeks of infection, we quantified 5365 unique proteins, including two HBV proteins (C/preC-derived and S), revealing subtle yet coordinated changes in the hepatocellular proteome. Early infection was characterized by selective alterations in cytoskeletal organization, extracellular matrix components, and focal adhesion pathways, alongside enrichment of complement-associated proteins. Notably, we identified a transient, specific increase in the abundance of complement component C5 without a corresponding change in C3, indicating differential regulation of complement pathway members during infection. These findings define a temporally resolved proteomic landscape of HBV–host interactions and uncover previously underappreciated complement dynamics consistent with a selective and restrained host response. Together, our results provide a framework for mechanistic studies of early viral infection and host adaptation.

The study quantified 5365 unique proteins across five time points, revealing coordinated changes in the hepatocellular proteome, including alterations in cytoskeletal organization, extracellular matrix components, and focal adhesion pathways. papers.title_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 感染的时间分辨蛋白质组学分析
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a major cause of chronic liver disease and hepatocellular carcinoma, yet its impact on host proteome dynamics during early infection remains poorly defined. Here, we performed time-resolved label-free quantitative (LFQ) proteomics to characterize the host response to HBV infection in human HepG2 hepatoma cells. Across five time points spanning the first 3 weeks of infection, we quantified 5365 unique proteins, including two HBV proteins (C/preC-derived and S), revealing subtle yet coordinated changes in the hepatocellular proteome. Early infection was characterized by selective alterations in cytoskeletal organization, extracellular matrix components, and focal adhesion pathways, alongside enrichment of complement-associated proteins. Notably, we identified a transient, specific increase in the abundance of complement component C5 without a corresponding change in C3, indicating differential regulation of complement pathway members during infection. These findings define a temporally resolved proteomic landscape of HBV–host interactions and uncover previously underappreciated complement dynamics consistent with a selective and restrained host response. Together, our results provide a framework for mechanistic studies of early viral infection and host adaptation.

papers.title: CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 axis beyond programmed cell death protein 1 in hepatitis B virus-associated hepatocellular carcinoma
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV)-associated hepatocellular carcinoma develops in a chronically inflamed, tolerogenic liver microenvironment. In this setting, T-cell dysfunction limits the efficacy of programmed death-1 (PD-1) blockade. Emerging evidence from Liu et al published in the World Journal of Gastrointestinal Oncology suggests that CD161 may represent an additional inhibitory axis within exhausted CD8+ T cells that is not fully captured by the PD-1/ programmed death ligand-1 pathway. In their study, CD161+CD8+ T cells were enriched in tumor tissue, and CD161 expression persisted even as PD-1+ compartments contracted after PD-1 inhibition, suggesting that CD161-mediated restraint may remain active under therapeutic pressure. Mechanistically, sustained engagement of the CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 interaction may impair T-cell effector function and contribute to adaptive immune resistance in the HBV-infected liver. These findings highlight the importance of protein-level assessment of CD161 and parallel evaluation with PD-1 to accurately characterize immune inhibition. Key knowledge gaps include the cellular source of lectin-like transcript 1 within the tumor microenvironment, the influence of ongoing HBV virological activity on CD161+ T-cell subsets, and the identification of clinically meaningful progression endpoints. In this editorial, we place these findings in mechanistic and translational context, highlighting the potential role of the CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 axis as a complementary pathway of immune resistance beyond PD-1 blockade. Collectively, the current evidence supports a cautious, hypothesis-driven translational strategy to evaluate combined modulation of the CD161 and PD-1 axes in carefully selected patients with HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.

papers.abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 相关肝细胞癌在慢性炎症、耐受性肝脏微环境中发生。在这种情况下,T 细胞功能障碍限制了程序性死亡 1 (PD-1) 阻断的功效。Liu 等人发表在《世界胃肠肿瘤学杂志》上的新证据表明,CD161 可能代表耗尽的 CD8+ T 细胞内的另一个抑制轴,该轴未被 PD-1/程序性死亡配体-1 通路完全捕获。在他们的研究中,CD161+CD8+T细胞在肿瘤组织中富集,即使PD-1+区室在PD-1抑制后收缩,CD161表达仍然持续,这表明CD161介导的抑制可能在治疗压力下保持活跃。从机制上讲,CD161-凝集素样转录物 1 相互作用的持续参与可能会损害 T 细胞效应器功能,并有助于 HBV 感染肝脏中的适应性免疫抵抗。这些发现强调了 CD161 蛋白质水平评估和 PD-1 平行评估对于准确表征免疫抑制的重要性。关键知识差距包括肿瘤微环境中凝集素样转录物 1 的细胞来源、持续的 HBV 病毒学活性对 CD161+ T 细胞亚群的影响,以及临床有意义的进展终点的识别。在这篇社论中,我们将这些发现置于机制和转化背景中,强调了 CD161 凝集素样转录物 1 轴作为 PD-1 阻断之外的免疫抵抗的补充途径的潜在作用。总的来说,当前的证据支持谨慎的、假设驱动的转化策略,以评估精心挑选的 HBV 相关肝细胞癌患者中 CD161 和 PD-1 轴的联合调节。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究旨在调查 HBV 相关肝细胞癌患者肿瘤组织中的 CD161 凝集素样转录物 1 轴。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究涉及分析 HBV 相关肝细胞癌患者的肿瘤组织样本,重点关注 CD161 表达及其与 PD-1 的相互作用。
analysis_zh.main_results: CD161+CD8+T细胞在肿瘤组织中富集,即使在PD-1抑制后CD161表达仍然持续,表明持续的免疫抵抗。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,CD161 介导的抑制可能在治疗压力下保持活跃,凸显了在 HBV 相关肝细胞癌中评估 CD161 与 PD-1 的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为针对 HBV 相关肝细胞癌患者的 CD161 和 PD-1 轴的联合调节策略的开发提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 主要局限性包括需要进一步研究凝集素样转录物 1 的细胞来源以及持续的 HBV 病毒学活性对 CD161+ T 细胞亚群的影响。

papers.title: Seroprevalence of hepatitis B and hepatitis C and its trends in India: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B (HBV) and Hepatitis C (HCV) are major public health challenges in India. Yet, the existing prevalence studies differ significantly regarding population characteristics, geographic location, and study design, complicating the interpretation of the overall disease burden. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to synthesize HBV and HCV seroprevalence in India from available evidence and identify variations across key subpopulations. A systematic search was conducted on PubMed, Embase, and Scopus for studies published from January 1999 to September 2024 reporting HBV and/or HCV seroprevalence in India. Following PRISMA guidelines, 87 studies (61 on HBV, 69 on HCV) were included. Given substantial heterogeneity across studies, pooled seroprevalence was estimated using a random-effects model. Subgroup analyses were conducted by publication year, study setting, population, and geographical region to explore variability. Eighty-seven studies reporting HBV or HCV seroprevalence in India were included. Considerable heterogeneity was observed across studies ( I 2 > 99%), reflecting differences in study populations, geographic regions, and study settings. The pooled seroprevalence was 3.0% [95% CI 2.0–4.0%] for HBV (HBsAg + ) ( n = 693,879 participants) and 4.0% [95% CI: 2.0–7.0%] for anti-HCV antibody ( n = 1,079,706 participants). However, substantial variation was observed across study populations. HBV prevalence ranged from approximately 1.0% among blood donors to higher levels in community-based settings (7.0%) and high-risk populations (4.0%). Geographically, HBV prevalence was highest in Northern (3.0%) and Western (3.0%) India. For HCV, prevalence was markedly higher among high-risk populations (11.0%). Regional analysis showed the highest HCV seroprevalence in Eastern India (10.0%) and Northern India (6.0%). Molecular confirmatory tests such as reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR), HBV DNA, or HCV RNA detection were reported in 19 of the 87 included studies (21.8%); chemiluminescent microparticle immunoassay (CMIA) was classified as a serological immunoassay rather than a molecular method. These findings indicate considerable heterogeneity in the epidemiology of viral hepatitis across populations in India. This study highlights the persistent burden of HBV and HCV in India. Scaling up community-based screening, decentralizing molecular testing, and improving linkage-to-care are essential to strengthen India’s National Viral Hepatitis Control Programme (NVHCP) and to achieve the WHO 2030 Viral Hepatitis elimination targets. Systematic review registration: PROSPERO CRD42024576147

papers.title: A composite lymph node-targeting nanoadjuvant NA@DCM integrates TLR9 and mitochondrial metabolic reprogramming for enhanced hepatitis B vaccination
papers.abstract: : Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global public health concern. Although hepatitis B subunit vaccines are safe and effective, improved adjuvants may further enhance their immunogenicity. We developed NA@DCM, an aluminum-based composite nanoadjuvant in which DSPE-PEG 2000 nanomicelles incorporating a covalently conjugated DSPE-PEG–CpG 1018 (DC) conjugate are interfacially assembled with nano-aluminum (NA). We evaluated draining lymph node (dLN) biodistribution, immunogenicity, and biosafety in murine models, and examined B-cell activation mechanisms by transcriptomic, Western blot, and pharmacological inhibition analyses. NA@DCM enhanced CpG-associated accumulation in dLNs at 6 h versus free CpG, with sustained retention and component colocalization over 48 h. Compared with its individual components and their physical mixture, NA@DCM increased antigen-specific IgG titers, the IgG2c/IgG1 ratio, IFN-γ + /TNF-α + / IL-2 + /IL-4 + CD4 + and CD8 + T cells, and germinal center responses, and matched an AS04-like reference formulation in total IgG. These features are consistent with a Th1-biased antibody profile. Mechanistically, NA@DCM enhanced Toll-like receptor 9 (TLR9)–NF-κB signaling and mitochondrial function, with increased superoxide-associated fluorescence, ATP production, and respiratory chain complex activities . Oligomycin A inhibition of ATP synthase attenuated bioenergetic responses and CD69/CD86 upregulation in human Namalwa and primary murine B cells, indicating mitochondrial ATP synthesis is required for NA@DCM-induced B-cell activation. NA@DCM showed favorable hemocompatibility in vitro and no overt acute toxicity in vivo ; repeated immunization induced early cytokine responses and local infiltration without detectable hepatic or renal abnormalities. Collectively, NA@DCM integrates lymph node-targeted delivery, TLR9-associated signaling, and mitochondrial bioenergetic modulation, supporting further preclinical development as a hepatitis B vaccine adjuvant.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces NA@DCM, a novel nanoadjuvant designed to enhance hepatitis B vaccination by integrating TLR9 signaling and mitochondrial metabolic reprogramming. The research aimed to evaluate its biodistribution, immunogenicity, and biosafety in murine models, with a focus on B-cell activation mechanisms. Results showed that NA@DCM significantly increased antigen-specific IgG titers, the IgG2c/IgG1 ratio, and T-cell responses compared to its individual components. Mechanistically, the nanoadjuvant enhanced TLR9–NF-κB signaling and mitochondrial function, with evidence that mitochondrial ATP synthesis is essential for B-cell activation. The study also demonstrated favorable hemocompatibility and safety profiles in vitro and in vivo. These findings suggest that NA@DCM could be a promising candidate for improving hepatitis B vaccine efficacy. However, the study is limited to murine models, and further research is needed to confirm its effectiveness in humans.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染仍然是全球主要的公共卫生问题。尽管乙型肝炎亚基疫苗安全有效,但改进的佐剂可能会进一步增强其免疫原性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们开发了 NA@DCM,一种铝基复合纳米佐剂,其中包含共价缀合 DSPE-PEG-CpG 1018 (DC) 缀合物的 DSPE-PEG 2000 纳米胶束与纳米铝 (NA) 进行界面组装。我们评估了小鼠模型中引流淋巴结 (dLN) 的生物分布、免疫原性和生物安全性,并通过转录组学、蛋白质印迹和药理学抑制分析检查了 B 细胞激活机制。
elements_zh.methods: 与其单独成分及其物理混合物相比,NA@DCM 增加了抗原特异性 IgG 滴度、IgG2c/IgG1 比率、IFN-γ + /TNF-α + / IL-2 + /IL-4 + CD4 + 和 CD8 + T 细胞以及生发中心反应,并与总 IgG 中的 AS04 样参考制剂相匹配。
elements_zh.main_results: NA@DCM 增强了 Toll 样受体 9 (TLR9​​)–NF-κB 信号传导和线粒体功能,并增加了超氧化物相关荧光、ATP 产生和呼吸链复合物活性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: Oligomycin A 对 ATP 合酶的抑制减弱了人 Namalwa 和原代小鼠 B 细胞中的生物能反应和 CD69/CD86 上调,表明线粒体 ATP 合成是 NA@DCM 诱导的 B 细胞激活所必需的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: NA@DCM 在体外表现出良好的血液相容性,在体内无明显的急性毒性;重复免疫诱导早期细胞因子反应和局部浸润,但未检测到肝脏或肾脏异常。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 总的来说,NA@DCM 整合了淋巴结靶向递送、TLR9 相关信号传导和线粒体生物能调节,支持作为乙型肝炎 疫苗 佐剂的进一步临床前开发。

papers.title: Chemiluminescence immunoassay and nucleic acid testing for TTI screening: A narrative review of performance, complementarity, and blood safety
papers.abstract: Introduction: Screening for transfusion-transmitted infections (TTIs) is essential to blood safety. Chemiluminescence immunoassay (ChLIA) enables automated, high-throughput serological screening, whereas nucleic acid testing (NAT) detects viral nucleic acids and reduces the diagnostic window period. This review aimed to evaluate ChLIA for screening hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), and syphilis; compare its performance with NAT for HBV, HCV, and HIV; and examine the implications for transfusion safety.Methods: A directed narrative review was conducted by a single reviewer (A.K.). PubMed was searched on September 7, 2026, using a predefined, reproducible search strategy. Supplementary searches included peer-reviewed journals, reference lists, World Health Organization publications, and official Indonesian regulatory sources. Studies were prioritized according to their relevance to blood donor screening, ChLIA–NAT comparisons, residual transfusion risk, occult HBV infection, and Indonesian regulatory requirements. Uncertain records underwent full-text assessment.Results: The included studies varied in assay characteristics, screening markers, donor populations, and reference standards, precluding meaningful pooling or generalization of diagnostic accuracy estimates. ChLIA and NAT detect distinct biological targets, with their relative contributions to blood safety influenced by pathogen epidemiology, residual risk, regulatory requirements, and healthcare resources. Findings from Shahin et al. and the Indonesian study are presented with their respective denominators and discordant testing patterns to ensure appropriate interpretation.Conclusion: ChLIA demonstrates high diagnostic performance, although accuracy varies across assays and clinical settings. Its complementary use with NAT may enhance transfusion safety when guided by pathogen-specific residual risk, local epidemiology, regulatory requirements, and healthcare capacity. Both approaches should be integrated within comprehensive quality assurance and hemovigilance systems.

This review aimed to evaluate ChLIA for screening hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), and syphilis; compare its performance with NAT for HBV, HCV, and HIV; and examine the implications for transfusion safety.

PubMed was searched on September 7, 2026, using a predefined, reproducible search strategy. Supplementary searches included peer-reviewed journals, reference lists, World Health Organization publications, and official Indonesian regulatory sources. Uncertain records underwent full-text assessment.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: ChLIA demonstrates high diagnostic performance, although accuracy varies across assays and clinical settings. analysis.summary_en: This narrative review evaluates the performance of chemiluminescence immunoassay (ChLIA) for screening hepatitis B virus (HBV), alongside its comparison with nucleic acid testing (NAT) for HBV, hepatitis C virus (HCV), and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV). The review emphasizes the importance of ChLIA in automated, high-throughput serological screening and the role of NAT in reducing the diagnostic window period. It concludes that ChLIA demonstrates high diagnostic performance, though accuracy varies across assays and clinical settings. The complementary use of ChLIA and NAT is recommended to enhance transfusion safety, guided by pathogen-specific residual risk, local epidemiology, regulatory requirements, and healthcare capacity. The review also highlights the need for integrating these methods within comprehensive quality assurance and hemovigilance systems. However, the included studies varied in assay characteristics, screening markers, donor populations, and reference standards, precluding meaningful pooling or generalization of diagnostic accuracy estimates.

papers.title_zh: 用于 TTI 筛查的化学发光免疫分析和核酸检测:性能、互补性和血液安全性的叙述性回顾
papers.source_body_en: Introduction: Screening for transfusion-transmitted infections (TTIs) is essential to blood safety. Chemiluminescence immunoassay (ChLIA) enables automated, high-throughput serological screening, whereas nucleic acid testing (NAT) detects viral nucleic acids and reduces the diagnostic window period. This review aimed to evaluate ChLIA for screening hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), and syphilis; compare its performance with NAT for HBV, HCV, and HIV; and examine the implications for transfusion safety.Methods: A directed narrative review was conducted by a single reviewer (A.K.). PubMed was searched on September 7, 2026, using a predefined, reproducible search strategy. Supplementary searches included peer-reviewed journals, reference lists, World Health Organization publications, and official Indonesian regulatory sources. Studies were prioritized according to their relevance to blood donor screening, ChLIA–NAT comparisons, residual transfusion risk, occult HBV infection, and Indonesian regulatory requirements. Uncertain records underwent full-text assessment.Results: The included studies varied in assay characteristics, screening markers, donor populations, and reference standards, precluding meaningful pooling or generalization of diagnostic accuracy estimates. ChLIA and NAT detect distinct biological targets, with their relative contributions to blood safety influenced by pathogen epidemiology, residual risk, regulatory requirements, and healthcare resources. Findings from Shahin et al. and the Indonesian study are presented with their respective denominators and discordant testing patterns to ensure appropriate interpretation.Conclusion: ChLIA demonstrates high diagnostic performance, although accuracy varies across assays and clinical settings. Its complementary use with NAT may enhance transfusion safety when guided by pathogen-specific residual risk, local epidemiology, regulatory requirements, and healthcare capacity. Both approaches should be integrated within comprehensive quality assurance and hemovigilance systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 简介:输血传播感染 (TTI) 筛查对于血液安全至关重要。化学发光免疫分析 (ChLIA) 可实现自动化、高通量血清学筛查,而核酸检测 (NAT) 可检测病毒核酸并缩短诊断窗口期。本综述旨在评估 ChLIA 筛查 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV)、丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV)、人类免疫缺陷病毒 (HIV) 和梅毒的效果;将其与 NAT 对 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 的性能进行比较;方法:由一位评审员 (A.K.) 进行定向叙述评审。PubMed 于 2026 年 9 月 7 日使用预定义的、可重复的搜索策略进行了搜索。补充检索包括同行评审期刊、参考文献列表、世界卫生组织出版物和印度尼西亚官方监管来源。根据与献血者筛查、ChLIA-NAT 比较、残余输血风险、隐匿性 HBV 感染和印度尼西亚监管要求的相关性,对研究进行优先排序。不确定的记录进行了全文评估。结果:纳入的研究在测定特征、筛选标记、供体群体和参考标准方面各不相同,排除了诊断准确性估计的有意义的汇总或概括。ChLIA 和 NAT 检测不同的生物靶标,其对血液安全的相对贡献受病原体 流行病学、残留风险、监管要求和医疗资源的影响。Shahin 等人的研究结果。印度尼西亚的研究提供了各自的分母和不一致的测试模式,以确保正确的解释。结论:ChLIA 表现出较高的诊断性能,尽管准确性因检测和临床环境而异。在病原体特异性残留风险、当地 流行病学、监管要求和医疗保健能力的指导下,它与 NAT 的补充使用可以提高输血安全性。这两种方法都应整合到全面的质量保证和血液警戒系统中。

papers.title: Pegylated interferon α-2b add-on to nucleos(t)ide analogues reduces hepatocellular carcinoma and decompensation in advanced fibrotic chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND The current therapeutic strategy of adding pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) α-2b to nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) is primarily aimed at achieving functional cure. However, its value in improving prognosis and the suitable candidates for this combination strategy in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis remain to be further explored. AIM To evaluate the long-term prognosis benefit of add-on Peg-IFNα-2b therapy in patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. METHODS This retrospective cohort study enrolled patients diagnosed with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. Participants were divided into two groups: (1) Those receiving combination therapy (Peg-IFNα-2b add-on to ongoing NA treatment); and (2) Those receiving NA monotherapy. A 1:1 propensity score matching approach was applied to balance baseline characteristics between groups. In survival analysis, the outcomes of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and decompensated cirrhosis were stratified by baseline clinical features and established HCC risk scores. RESULTS The analysis included 302 matched pairs, with a median follow-up duration of 220 weeks. Combination therapy was associated with a significantly lower risk of developing HCC (hazard ratio = 0.22; 95%CI: 0.11-0.48) and decompensated cirrhosis (hazard ratio = 0.39; 95%CI: 0.20-0.77) than NA monotherapy. These benefits were particularly pronounced among patients classified as intermediate-to-high risk by validated HCC prediction models and in those with persistent biochemical abnormalities lasting > 12 months. CONCLUSION Add-on therapy with Peg-IFNα-2b to NAs is significantly associated with reduced HCC and decompensation in high-risk patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or cirrhosis, supporting its use in this population.

Propensity score matching was applied to balance baseline characteristics, and survival analysis was stratified by clinical features and HCC risk scores. The results showed that combination therapy significantly reduced the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and decompensated cirrhosis compared to monotherapy, with hazard ratios of 0.22 (95%CI: 0.11-0.48) and 0.39 (95%CI: 0.20-0.77), respectively. However, the study's retrospective nature introduces limitations, and the evidence is moderate due to reliance on matching and stratified analysis.

papers.title_zh: 聚乙二醇化干扰素 α-2b 添加到核苷(酸)类似物可减少肝细胞癌和晚期纤维化的失代偿 慢性乙型肝炎
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND The current therapeutic strategy of adding pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) α-2b to nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) is primarily aimed at achieving functional cure. However, its value in improving prognosis and the suitable candidates for this combination strategy in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis remain to be further explored. AIM To evaluate the long-term prognosis benefit of add-on Peg-IFNα-2b therapy in patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. METHODS This retrospective cohort study enrolled patients diagnosed with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. Participants were divided into two groups: (1) Those receiving combination therapy (Peg-IFNα-2b add-on to ongoing NA treatment); and (2) Those receiving NA monotherapy. A 1:1 propensity score matching approach was applied to balance baseline characteristics between groups. In survival analysis, the outcomes of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and decompensated cirrhosis were stratified by baseline clinical features and established HCC risk scores. RESULTS The analysis included 302 matched pairs, with a median follow-up duration of 220 weeks. Combination therapy was associated with a significantly lower risk of developing HCC (hazard ratio = 0.22; 95%CI: 0.11-0.48) and decompensated cirrhosis (hazard ratio = 0.39; 95%CI: 0.20-0.77) than NA monotherapy. These benefits were particularly pronounced among patients classified as intermediate-to-high risk by validated HCC prediction models and in those with persistent biochemical abnormalities lasting > 12 months. CONCLUSION Add-on therapy with Peg-IFNα-2b to NAs is significantly associated with reduced HCC and decompensation in high-risk patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or cirrhosis, supporting its use in this population.

papers.title: PREVALENCE AND EPIDEMIOLOGICAL PROFILE OF HEPATITIS B VIRUS INFECTION IN A POPULATION SAMPLE FROM SOUTHERN ROMANIA: A FOUR-YEAR RETROSPECTIVE ANALYSIS (2021–2024)
papers.abstract: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health challenge. The present retrospective study evaluated the HBsAg seroprevalence in a sample of 5501 patients tested in Alexandria (Teleorman County) between 2021 and 2024 using rapid immunochromatographic methods. The overall seropositivity rate was 4.45 % (245 cases), with a significantly higher prevalence in males compared to females (5.62 % vs. 3.99 %, p = 0.0078; OR = 1.44). The age distribution showed a progressive increase reaching 5.68% in the 50–64 age group, whereas no positive cases were recorded in the under-18 age group, confirming the effectiveness of thenational HBV vaccination program launched in 1995. Temporal dynamics revealed a slight increase in annual prevalence from 3.95 % in 2022 to 5.04 % in 2024, highlighting the necessity of continuing population screening campaigns.
papers.journal: ANNALS OF THE UNIVERSITY OF CRAIOVA, Biology, Horticulture, Food products processing technology, Environmental engineering

papers.source_body_en: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health challenge. The present retrospective study evaluated the HBsAg seroprevalence in a sample of 5501 patients tested in Alexandria (Teleorman County) between 2021 and 2024 using rapid immunochromatographic methods. The overall seropositivity rate was 4.45 % (245 cases), with a significantly higher prevalence in males compared to females (5.62 % vs. 3.99 %, p = 0.0078; OR = 1.44). Temporal dynamics revealed a slight increase in annual prevalence from 3.95 % in 2022 to 5.04 % in 2024, highlighting the necessity of continuing population screening campaigns.

papers.title: Comparative Biomarker Profiles Across Stages of Chronic Hepatitis B
papers.abstract: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB), liver cirrhosis (LC), and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) are progressive stages of HBV infection that represent a global health concern. In many regions, advanced diagnostic tools are not readily available; therefore, accessible, cost-effective assays are needed to differentiate these disease stages. This study compared inflammatory, biochemical, and virological biomarker profiles, encompassing the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), platelet count, aspartate transaminase (AST), alanine transaminase (ALT), AST-to-platelet ratio index (APRI), fibrosis-4 score (FIB-4), and HBV DNA levels, across HBV-related liver disease stages. A retrospective cross-sectional study enrolled 213 patients with chronic HBV infection, categorized as CHB (n=166), LC (n=27), and HCC (n=20) at The General Hospital of West Nusa Tenggara Province between January 2022 and December 2023. The Kruskal-Wallis and post hoc tests were used for the analysis. The NLR was significantly higher in the HCC group compared to both the CHB (p=0.0001) and LC (p<0.01) groups. Platelet count revealed a progressive decline from CHB to LC (p<0.0001) but exhibited a subsequent increase from LC to HCC (p<0.0001), with no significant difference observed between the CHB and HCC groups. Aspartate transaminase (AST) levels increased significantly across all disease stages, whereas ALT levels showed no significant variation. Both APRI and FIB-4 scores were significantly higher in the LC and HCC groups compared to the CHB group (p<0.0001), but did not differ between LC and HCC. HBV DNA levels were elevated in HCC but failed to reach statistical significance. Consequently, these accessible biomarkers could play an important role in monitoring and staging HBV-induced liver disease in settings lacking advanced diagnostic facilities.
papers.journal: INDONESIAN JOURNAL OF CLINICAL PATHOLOGY AND MEDICAL LABORATORY

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to compare inflammatory, biochemical, and virological biomarker profiles across stages of HBV infection, including chronic hepatitis B (CHB), liver cirrhosis (LC), and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB)、肝硬化 (LC) 和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 是 HBV 感染的进展阶段,代表着全球健康问题。本研究旨在比较这些阶段的生物标志物概况,以确定可用于疾病分期且具有成本效益的标志物。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项回顾性横断面研究招募了 2022 年 1 月至 2023 年 12 月期间在西努沙登加拉省总医院入组的 213 名慢性 HBV 感染患者,分为 CHB (n=166)、LC (n=27) 和 HCC (n=20)。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用 Kruskal-Wallis 和事后检验进行分析。它比较了炎症、生化和病毒学生物标志物,包括中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比率 (NLR)、血小板计数、天冬氨酸转氨酶 (AST)、丙氨酸转氨酶 (ALT)、AST 与血小板比率指数 (APRI)、纤维化 4 评分 (FIB-4) 和 HBV DNA 水平。
elements_zh.main_results: 与 CHB (p=0.0001) 和 LC (p<0.01) 组相比,HCC 组的 NLR 显着较高。血小板计数显示从 CHB 到 LC 逐渐下降 (p<0.0001),但随后从 LC 到 HCC 逐渐增加 (p<0.0001),在 CHB 和 HCC 组之间没有观察到显着差异。AST 水平在所有疾病阶段均显着增加,而 ALT 水平没有显着变化。与 CHB 组相比,LC 和 HCC 组的 APRI 和 FIB-4 评分均显着较高 (p<0.0001),但 LC 和 HCC 之间没有差异。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,某些生物标志物,例如 NLR 和 APRI,可能有助于区分疾病阶段,特别是在资源有限、无法获得先进诊断工具的环境中。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可以为开发可利用的生物标志物提供信息,用于在诊断资源有限的地区监测和分期乙型肝炎引起的肝病。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和潜在的选择偏倚而受到限制。然而,鉴于结果的统计显着性和成熟生物标志物的使用,证据是强有力的。

HBV DNA levels were elevated in HCC but failed to reach statistical significance.
