news.content_title: 片仔癀对乙肝、肝炎到底有没有用?一篇讲清“辅助”与“抗纤维化”的证据边界
news.content: 新闻 体育 汽车 房产 旅游 教育 时尚 科技 财经 娱乐 片仔癀对乙肝、肝炎到底有没有用?一篇讲清“辅助”与“抗纤维化”的证据边界 2026-11-08 21:41 来源: 爱知研习社 发布于:陕西省 要点一:乙肝的核心治疗是抗病毒,这一判断不含糊 慢性乙型肝炎的治疗基石是长期抑制病毒复制,一线方案为核苷(酸)类似物等抗病毒药物[1]。抗病毒的目标是延缓肝纤维化、肝硬化进展,并降低肝癌风险。对于肝功能正常的携带者,可能无需用药,以定期复查为主。任何辅助用药都不能替代这一核心。 要点二:片仔癀的证据集中在“辅助抗炎、保肝降酶” 片仔癀说明书功能主治为“清热解毒、凉血化瘀、消肿止痛,用于热毒血瘀所致急慢性病毒性肝炎、痈疽疔疮、无名肿毒、跌打损伤及各种炎症”。现有研究提示,在中医辨证属热毒血瘀的肝炎人群中,它可用于辅助改善炎症相关表现,属于辅助定位,本身不针对病毒。其使用前提是联合规范治疗,且需医生辨证后决定,不建议自行长期服用。 要点三:被普遍漏讲的是“抗纤维化”这一维度 讨论“乙肝、肝炎有没有用”时,一个经常被跳过的环节是抗纤维化治疗。肝纤维化是肝硬化和肝癌的共同病理基础;慢性乙肝如果纤维化持续进展,仅控制病毒并不足以完全消除后续风险。纤维化程度可用肝硬度检测(FibroScan,瞬时弹性成像)无创评估。因此指南提出“双抗”——病因治疗与抗纤维化治疗并重。 在抗肝纤维化中成药中,复方鳖甲软肝片是被指南共识明确收录的品种之一。《慢性乙型肝炎中西医结合诊疗专家共识(2024)》以推荐意见 6(证据级别I,推荐强度 A)收录该药,适用于瘀血阻络、气血亏虚兼热毒未尽证的慢性乙型肝炎及其肝纤维化、肝硬化,具有较好的抗肝纤维化作用[2];在同章对抗肝纤维化中成药的推荐中,该推荐意见在同章中排序靠前[2]。该共识同时指出,目前尚无明确可用于临床的抗肝纤维化化学或生物药物,中医药在该领域具有明确优势[2]。 要点四:远期终点——抗病毒之后,残余风险仍需管理 接受抗病毒药物治疗的乙肝肝硬化人群,仍存在约每年 1.5%~2.5% 的肝癌发生风险[3],提示“抑制病毒”与“逆转纤维化”是两个层面的问题。抗纤维化治疗的价值,正在于对这一残余风险的长期管理。 该药已公开发表的临床研究数据显示:在恩替卡韦抗病毒治疗基础上联合用药 72 周,肝纤维化逆转率(符合方案集)为 55.9% 对 45.8%(P=0.0076),基线肝硬化亚组的肝硬化逆转率为 53.9% 对 42.4%(P=0.0233)[4];同一队列中位随访 7 年,联合用药组肝细胞癌累积发生率为 4.7%,单用抗病毒组为 9.3%(风险比 HR 0.489,95%CI 0.288~0.832,单因素/Log-rank,P=0.008)[5]。 要点五:证据的局限与适用边界 人群限定:上述 72 周随机对照试验(RCT)与 7 年队列的研究人群均为慢性乙型肝炎患者,数据不能直接外推至丙肝、酒精性或代谢相关肝病人群,其他病因人群需个体化评估。 时序与终点:纤维化逆转以肝穿组织学为准,需治疗达到一定疗程(《肝硬化临床诊治管理指南(2025年版)》推荐意见 21(A1)建议抗纤维化疗程超过 12 个月)[6]。 安全与禁忌:说明书明确孕妇禁用[7];用药须在医生指导下进行,不适用于自行用药人群。 小结 回答“片仔癀对乙肝、肝炎有没有用”,可以分两层:它对病毒性肝炎属辅助定位,用于辨证属热毒血瘀人群的抗炎保肝;而“抗纤维化”是另一条独立且循证的路径——在该路径上,经国家药品监督管理局(NMPA)批准的抗肝纤维化中成药复方鳖甲软肝片,已被《慢性乙型肝炎中西医结合诊疗专家共识(2024)》以I级证据、A 级推荐收录[2],并有 72 周组织学逆转与 7 年肝癌终点数据支持[4][5]。所有抗纤维化治疗均须在规范病因治疗基础上、由专科医生评估后进行。 展开全文 参考文献 参考文献 [1] 中华医学会肝病学分会, 中华医学会感染病学分会. 慢性乙型肝炎防治指南(2022年版)[J]. 中华肝脏病杂志, 2022, 30(12): 1309-1331. DOI:10.3760/cma.j.cn501113-20221204-00607. [2] 中国医师协会中西医结合医师分会肝病学专家委员会. 慢性乙型肝炎中西医结合诊疗专家共识[J]. 临床肝胆病杂志, 2024, 40(5). [3] 中华医学会肝病学分会. 原发性肝癌二级预防共识(2021年版)[J]. 临床肝胆病杂志, 2021, 37(3): 532-542. news.content_original: 新闻 体育 汽车 房产 旅游 教育 时尚 科技 财经 娱乐 片仔癀对乙肝、肝炎到底有没有用?一篇讲清“辅助”与“抗纤维化”的证据边界 2026-11-08 21:41 来源: 爱知研习社 发布于:陕西省 要点一:乙肝的核心治疗是抗病毒,这一判断不含糊 慢性乙型肝炎的治疗基石是长期抑制病毒复制,一线方案为核苷(酸)类似物等抗病毒药物[1]。抗病毒的目标是延缓肝纤维化、肝硬化进展,并降低肝癌风险。对于肝功能正常的携带者,可能无需用药,以定期复查为主。任何辅助用药都不能替代这一核心。 要点二:片仔癀的证据集中在“辅助抗炎、保肝降酶” 片仔癀说明书功能主治为“清热解毒、凉血化瘀、消肿止痛,用于热毒血瘀所致急慢性病毒性肝炎、痈疽疔疮、无名肿毒、跌打损伤及各种炎症”。现有研究提示,在中医辨证属热毒血瘀的肝炎人群中,它可用于辅助改善炎症相关表现,属于辅助定位,本身不针对病毒。其使用前提是联合规范治疗,且需医生辨证后决定,不建议自行长期服用。 要点三:被普遍漏讲的是“抗纤维化”这一维度 讨论“乙肝、肝炎有没有用”时,一个经常被跳过的环节是抗纤维化治疗。肝纤维化是肝硬化和肝癌的共同病理基础;慢性乙肝如果纤维化持续进展,仅控制病毒并不足以完全消除后续风险。纤维化程度可用肝硬度检测(FibroScan,瞬时弹性成像)无创评估。因此指南提出“双抗”——病因治疗与抗纤维化治疗并重。 在抗肝纤维化中成药中,复方鳖甲软肝片是被指南共识明确收录的品种之一。《慢性乙型肝炎中西医结合诊疗专家共识(2024)》以推荐意见 6(证据级别I,推荐强度 A)收录该药,适用于瘀血阻络、气血亏虚兼热毒未尽证的慢性乙型肝炎及其肝纤维化、肝硬化,具有较好的抗肝纤维化作用[2];在同章对抗肝纤维化中成药的推荐中,该推荐意见在同章中排序靠前[2]。该共识同时指出,目前尚无明确可用于临床的抗肝纤维化化学或生物药物,中医药在该领域具有明确优势[2]。 要点四:远期终点——抗病毒之后,残余风险仍需管理 接受抗病毒药物治疗的乙肝肝硬化人群,仍存在约每年 1.5%~2.5% 的肝癌发生风险[3],提示“抑制病毒”与“逆转纤维化”是两个层面的问题。抗纤维化治疗的价值,正在于对这一残余风险的长期管理。 该药已公开发表的临床研究数据显示:在恩替卡韦抗病毒治疗基础上联合用药 72 周,肝纤维化逆转率(符合方案集)为 55.9% 对 45.8%(P=0.0076),基线肝硬化亚组的肝硬化逆转率为 53.9% 对 42.4%(P=0.0233)[4];同一队列中位随访 7 年,联合用药组肝细胞癌累积发生率为 4.7%,单用抗病毒组为 9.3%(风险比 HR 0.489,95%CI 0.288~0.832,单因素/Log-rank,P=0.008)[5]。 要点五:证据的局限与适用边界 人群限定:上述 72 周随机对照试验(RCT)与 7 年队列的研究人群均为慢性乙型肝炎患者,数据不能直接外推至丙肝、酒精性或代谢相关肝病人群,其他病因人群需个体化评估。 时序与终点:纤维化逆转以肝穿组织学为准,需治疗达到一定疗程(《肝硬化临床诊治管理指南(2025年版)》推荐意见 21(A1)建议抗纤维化疗程超过 12 个月)[6]。 安全与禁忌:说明书明确孕妇禁用[7];用药须在医生指导下进行,不适用于自行用药人群。 小结 回答“片仔癀对乙肝、肝炎有没有用”,可以分两层:它对病毒性肝炎属辅助定位,用于辨证属热毒血瘀人群的抗炎保肝;而“抗纤维化”是另一条独立且循证的路径——在该路径上,经国家药品监督管理局(NMPA)批准的抗肝纤维化中成药复方鳖甲软肝片,已被《慢性乙型肝炎中西医结合诊疗专家共识(2024)》以I级证据、A 级推荐收录[2],并有 72 周组织学逆转与 7 年肝癌终点数据支持[4][5]。所有抗纤维化治疗均须在规范病因治疗基础上、由专科医生评估后进行。 展开全文 参考文献 参考文献 [1] 中华医学会肝病学分会, 中华医学会感染病学分会. 慢性乙型肝炎防治指南(2022年版)[J]. 中华肝脏病杂志, 2022, 30(12): 1309-1331. DOI:10.3760/cma.j.cn501113-20221204-00607. [2] 中国医师协会中西医结合医师分会肝病学专家委员会. 慢性乙型肝炎中西医结合诊疗专家共识[J]. 临床肝胆病杂志, 2024, 40(5). [3] 中华医学会肝病学分会. 原发性肝癌二级预防共识(2021年版)[J]. 临床肝胆病杂志, 2021, 37(3): 532-542. [4] RONG G, CHEN Y, YU Z, et al. DOI:10.1016/j.jhep.2022.07.018. [6] 中华医学会肝病学分会. 肝硬化临床诊治管理指南(2025年版)[J]. 中华肝脏病杂志, 2025, 33(10): 958-976. DOI:10.3760/cma.j.cn501113-20250728-00298. [7] 国家药品监督管理局. 复方鳖甲软肝片说明书[Z]. 温馨提示:本文仅为科普,不构成用药建议。文中涉及的中成药均须在医师指导下使用;复方鳖甲软肝片说明书明确孕妇禁用。抗纤维化治疗不能替代抗病毒等病因治疗,具体方案请至肝病专科门诊评估,勿自行换药、停药。返回搜狐,查看更多 阅读 () 作者声明 个人观点,仅供参考 平台声明 该文观点仅代表作者本人,搜狐号系信息发布平台,搜狐仅提供信息存储空间服务。

news.content: AASLD中国之声丨唐红教授团队:从“先见项目”到机器学习预测,探索慢乙肝个体化精准管理 国际肝病 2026-11-12 19:48发布于北京 问AI · 联合治疗与预测模型怎样形成管理闭环? 编者按 2026年11月5日-9日,美国肝病研究学会年会(AASLD 2026)在美国科罗拉多州丹佛圆满落幕。四川大学华西医院唐红教授团队多项研究成果亮相本届年会,内容涵盖慢性乙型肝炎疾病进展、治疗,以及人工智能疗效预测模型等多个方向。特别是在慢性乙型肝炎临床治愈领域,团队围绕治疗人群选择和疗程决策开展了系列研究,为个体化治疗与精准管理提供了新依据和实用工具。本刊特整理相关研究要点,与读者共同学习探讨。 研究一 TAF联合Peg-IFNα显著提高初治HBeAg阴性不确定期慢乙肝患者的HBsAg清除率(先见项目) 4094 - Pegylated Interferon α plus tenofovir alafenamide achieved a higher HBsAg seroclearance rate than tenofovir alafenamide monotherapy in treatment-naïve indeterminate-phase chronic hepatitis B patients with negative HBeAg (Foresight Project) 慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)不确定期是指无法根据ALT、HBeAg及HBV DNA等指标明确归入传统自然病程分期的患者,其中HBeAg阴性患者约占70%–85%。尽管部分患者ALT持续正常,仍存在肝硬化及肝细胞癌(HCC)的进展风险。然而针对初治、HBeAg阴性且ALT正常的不确定期患者,不同抗病毒治疗策略的疗效仍缺乏充分的直接比较证据。 唐红教授团队成员刘梦雅博士的研究,纳入183例初治、HBeAg阴性、ALT正常且HBV DNA阳性的不确定期慢乙肝患者,根据患者治疗意愿分别接受TAF单药治疗(n=42)或TAF联合Peg-IFNα治疗(n=141),疗程均为52周。研究以第52周HBV DNA转阴(< 20 IU/mL)为主要终点,以HBsAg清除(< 0.05 IU/mL)为次要终点,系统比较两种治疗策略的病毒学及血清学应答。 结果显示,两组患者均获得良好的病毒学抑制效果,第52周总体HBV DNA阴转率为88.0%(161/183)。其中,TAF单药组与联合治疗组的HBV DNA阴转率分别为92.9%和86.5%(P=0.402)。然而,两组在HBsAg清除方面表现出明显差异。TAF单药组治疗前后HBsAg水平无显著变化,且无患者实现HBsAg清除;联合治疗组HBsAg中位水平由基线的2.5 log10 IU/mL下降至第52周的1.1 log10 IU/mL,HBsAg清除率达到27.0%(38/141),显著高于单药组(P<0.05)。此外,在实现HBsAg清除的38例患者中,78.9%(30/38)进一步实现HBsAg血清学转换,第52周抗-HBs中位滴度达132.5 IU/L。 研究表明,对于既往治疗决策存在争议的初治、HBeAg阴性、ALT正常的不确定期慢乙肝患者,TAF单药与TAF联合Peg-IFNα均能实现较高水平的病毒学抑制,但联合治疗在促进HBsAg下降及清除方面优势明显。研究为探索不确定期慢乙肝患者的抗病毒策略提供了新的临床依据,为慢乙肝功能性治愈的个体化治疗策略提供新的思路。 研究二 机器学习与简化临床模型助力识别Peg-IFNα治疗24周后继续治疗的获益人群 4095 - Identifying chronic hepatitis B patients who benefit from continuing Peg-IFNα beyond Week 24: a machine learning and clinical model approach 慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)仍是全球肝硬化和肝细胞癌的重要病因。聚乙二醇干扰素α(Peg-IFNα)可促进乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)下降甚至清除,治疗第24周是重要的临床评估时间点。部分患者在治疗24周后继续用药的获益有限,继续治疗需承受更长的疗程及治疗负担。因此,如何在24周这一关键节点识别继续治疗的潜在获益人群,是优化Peg-IFNα个体化治疗的重要临床问题。 唐红教授团队成员王嘉毅博士后通过前瞻性纳入来自多中心的832例经核苷(酸)类似物(NAs)治疗、HBeAg阴性、HBsAg≤1500IU/mL的CHB患者,分析治疗24周时仍未实现HBsAg清除的患者继续治疗至48周发生获益的情况,并建立预测模型。继续治疗的获益定义为:治疗至48周时实现HBsAg清除(HBsAg<0.05IU/mL)或第24~48周HBsAg下降>1 log10 IU/mL。 结果显示,在615例加用Peg-IFNα治疗24周时HBsAg仍为阳性的患者中,159例(25.9%)在48周时达到获益标准。LASSO 回归及Boruta算法(1000× bootstrap)筛选出年龄和第24周HBsAg水平是最稳定的获益预测因素。进一步构建9种机器学习模型(LR、RF、DT、SVM、GB、XGB、LGBM、MLP及NB),多层感知机(MLP)模型表现最佳(AUC: 0.721),传统逻辑回归模型具有相近的预测性能(AUC: 0.716,P=0.185),并形成了更便于临床应用的分层标准:年龄<40岁且24周HBsAg<6.0 IU/mL者为高概率组,获益率达50.0%;年龄≥40岁且HBsAg≥6.0 IU/mL者为低概率组,获益率仅为9.4%;其余患者为中概率组,获益率为32.2%。 研究表明,年龄<40岁且治疗第24周HBsAg<6.0 IU/mL的患者更可能在加用Peg-IFNα的继续治疗中获益。该模型有望减少无效或低效治疗,推动CHB有限疗程治疗的精准化管理。 作者声明:健康医疗分享,仅供参考

Identifying chronic hepatitis B patients who benefit from continuing Peg-IFNα beyond Week 24: a machine learning and clinical model approach 慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)仍是全球肝硬化和肝细胞癌的重要病因。聚乙二醇干扰素α(Peg-IFNα)可促进乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)下降甚至清除,治疗第24周是重要的临床评估时间点。部分患者在治疗24周后继续用药的获益有限,继续治疗需承受更长的疗程及治疗负担。因此,如何在24周这一关键节点识别继续治疗的潜在获益人群,是优化Peg-IFNα个体化治疗的重要临床问题。 唐红教授团队成员王嘉毅博士后通过前瞻性纳入来自多中心的832例经核苷(酸)类似物(NAs)治疗、HBeAg阴性、HBsAg≤1500IU/mL的CHB患者,分析治疗24周时仍未实现HBsAg清除的患者继续治疗至48周发生获益的情况,并建立预测模型。继续治疗的获益定义为:治疗至48周时实现HBsAg清除(HBsAg<0.05IU/mL)或第24~48周HBsAg下降>1 log10 IU/mL。 结果显示,在615例加用Peg-IFNα治疗24周时HBsAg仍为阳性的患者中,159例(25.9%)在48周时达到获益标准。LASSO 回归及Boruta算法(1000× bootstrap)筛选出年龄和第24周HBsAg水平是最稳定的获益预测因素。进一步构建9种机器学习模型(LR、RF、DT、SVM、GB、XGB、LGBM、MLP及NB),多层感知机(MLP)模型表现最佳(AUC: 0.721),传统逻辑回归模型具有相近的预测性能(AUC: 0.716,P=0.185),并形成了更便于临床应用的分层标准:年龄<40岁且24周HBsAg<6.0 IU/mL者为高概率组,获益率达50.0%;年龄≥40岁且HBsAg≥6.0 IU/mL者为低概率组,获益率仅为9.4%;其余患者为中概率组,获益率为32.2%。 研究表明,年龄<40岁且治疗第24周HBsAg<6.0 IU/mL的患者更可能在加用Peg-IFNα的继续治疗中获益。该模型有望减少无效或低效治疗,推动CHB有限疗程治疗的精准化管理。 作者声明:健康医疗分享,仅供参考

analysis.event: A study by the Tang Hong professor team at Sichuan University Huaxi Hospital presented at the AASLD 2026 conference explored the efficacy of TAF monotherapy versus TAF combined with Peg-IFNα in treatment-naïve, HBeAg-negative, ALT-normal, and HBV DNA-positive CHB patients in the indeterminate phase. The study also introduced a machine learning model to identify patients who benefit from continuing Peg-IFNα treatment beyond 24 weeks.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: The study involved 183 patients in the first part and 832 patients in the second part. The research provides new clinical evidence for individualized treatment strategies in CHB management.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The study is a published research report with detailed methodology and results. It is not an outbreak or public health event but a clinical study. The findings are based on data from 2026 and are not subject to ongoing investigation.

analysis.brief_en: A study by the Tang Hong professor team at Sichuan University Huaxi Hospital, presented at the AASLD 2026 conference, explored the efficacy of TAF monotherapy versus TAF combined with Peg-IFNα in treatment-naïve, HBeAg-negative, ALT-normal, and HBV DNA-positive chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients in the indeterminate phase. The research found that the combination therapy significantly increased HBsAg clearance rates compared to TAF alone, with 27.0% of patients achieving HBsAg clearance. Additionally, the team developed a machine learning model to identify patients who benefit from continuing Peg-IFNα treatment beyond 24 weeks. The model showed that younger patients with lower HBsAg levels at week 24 had a higher likelihood of benefiting from extended treatment. These findings provide new clinical evidence for individualized treatment strategies in CHB management, aiming to improve precision and reduce unnecessary treatment burdens.

news.source_body_en: A study by the Tang Hong professor team at Sichuan University Huaxi Hospital, presented at the AASLD 2026 conference, explored the efficacy of TAF monotherapy versus TAF combined with Peg-IFNα in treatment-naïve, HBeAg-negative, ALT-normal, and HBV DNA-positive chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients in the indeterminate phase. The research found that the combination therapy significantly increased HBsAg clearance rates compared to TAF alone, with 27.0% of patients achieving HBsAg clearance. Additionally, the team developed a machine learning model to identify patients who benefit from continuing Peg-IFNα treatment beyond 24 weeks. The model showed that younger patients with lower HBsAg levels at week 24 had a higher likelihood of benefiting from extended treatment. These findings provide new clinical evidence for individualized treatment strategies in CHB management, aiming to improve precision and reduce unnecessary treatment burdens.
news.content_zh: 四川大学华西医院唐红教授团队在 AASLD 2026 会议上发表的一项研究,探讨了 TAF 单药治疗与 TAF 联合 Peg-IFNα 对 治疗 初治、HBeAg 阴性、ALT 正常和 HBV DNA 阳性 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 不确定期患者的疗效。研究发现,与单独使用 TAF 相比,联合治疗显着提高了 HBsAg 清除率,27.0% 的患者实现了 HBsAg 清除。此外,该团队还开发了一种机器学习模型来识别能够从持续 24 周以上的 Peg-IFNα 治疗 中受益的患者。该模型显示,第 24 周时 HBsAg 水平较低的年轻患者从延长的 治疗 中受益的可能性更高。这些发现为CHB管理中的个体化治疗策略提供了新的临床证据,旨在提高精准度并减少不必要的治疗负担。

news.content_title: Vir Biotechnology Hepatitis Delta Treatment Meets Phase III Goals, With 79% Virus-Free at Week 48
news.content: Vir Biotechnology Hepatitis Delta Treatment Meets Phase III Goals, With 79% Virus-Free at Week 48 3 min read VIR −7.69% From laggards to leaders: Small caps on the rise Vir Biotechnology VIR said its combination treatment for chronic hepatitis delta met the primary and key secondary endpoints in the pivotal Phase III ECLIPSE 1 trial, with 79% of treated patients achieving undetectable virus at 48 weeks. The company also presented longer-term Phase II data and an exploratory analysis suggesting that some patients maintained a viral response after stopping the regimen. President and CEO Marianne De Backer cautioned that the discontinuation findings involve a small group and require longer follow-up. Phase III Results Virios Therapeutics Up 75% on Fibromyalgia Phase 3 Proposal ECLIPSE 1 enrolled 124 patients randomized 2-to-1 to receive elebsiran and tobevibart or delayed treatment. The delayed-treatment group remained untreated for 12 weeks before crossing over to the combination. The primary endpoint required both undetectable hepatitis delta virus RNA and normalization of ALT, a measure associated with liver injury. At week 48, 44% of patients receiving the combination met that endpoint, compared with 0% of the delayed-treatment group at week 12. The comparison therefore used different assessment times for the two groups. For the key secondary endpoint, 79% of treated patients had undetectable virus at week 48, compared with 0% of the delayed-treatment group at week 12. De Backer said every treated patient achieved a virologic response, defined as undetectable virus or at least a two-log reduction in viral RNA. Approximately 55% of trial participants had compensated cirrhosis at enrollment. At week 48, about 85% of patients with compensated cirrhosis had undetectable virus, compared with 73% of those without cirrhosis. De Backer said the difference was not necessarily statistically significant. All treated patients completed 48 weeks of therapy without discontinuations or dose interruptions, according to De Backer. She said there were no serious adverse events and one treatment-related grade three event: a decrease in neutrophil count that resolved within 15 days without interrupting treatment. Flu-like symptoms were among the more common adverse events, predominantly after the first dose. Longer-Term and Off-Treatment Data In the Phase II SOLSTICE trial, all 28 patients who remained on combination treatment through week 96 had undetectable virus, De Backer said. ALT normalization was reported in 53% of all patients at that point. An exploratory analysis examined the first 10 patients who stopped the combination after maintaining undetectable virus for at least 96 weeks. All remained on background hepatitis B therapy and had sustained virologic responses for at least 12 weeks after stopping the combination. Seven had reached 24 weeks of follow-up, and one had reached 48 weeks. news.content_original: Vir Biotechnology Hepatitis Delta Treatment Meets Phase III Goals, With 79% Virus-Free at Week 48 3 min read VIR −7.69% From laggards to leaders: Small caps on the rise Vir Biotechnology VIR said its combination treatment for chronic hepatitis delta met the primary and key secondary endpoints in the pivotal Phase III ECLIPSE 1 trial, with 79% of treated patients achieving undetectable virus at 48 weeks. The company also presented longer-term Phase II data and an exploratory analysis suggesting that some patients maintained a viral response after stopping the regimen. President and CEO Marianne De Backer cautioned that the discontinuation findings involve a small group and require longer follow-up. Phase III Results Virios Therapeutics Up 75% on Fibromyalgia Phase 3 Proposal ECLIPSE 1 enrolled 124 patients randomized 2-to-1 to receive elebsiran and tobevibart or delayed treatment. The delayed-treatment group remained untreated for 12 weeks before crossing over to the combination. The primary endpoint required both undetectable hepatitis delta virus RNA and normalization of ALT, a measure associated with liver injury. At week 48, 44% of patients receiving the combination met that endpoint, compared with 0% of the delayed-treatment group at week 12. The comparison therefore used different assessment times for the two groups. For the key secondary endpoint, 79% of treated patients had undetectable virus at week 48, compared with 0% of the delayed-treatment group at week 12. De Backer said every treated patient achieved a virologic response, defined as undetectable virus or at least a two-log reduction in viral RNA. According to research published in BMC Immunology, circulating T-cell receptor repertoires demonstrate distinct diversity, overlap, and segment usage patterns across these clinical cohorts. T cells play a vital role during hepatitis B virus infection by mediating both protective immunity and immunopathology. In-depth profiling of the complementarity-determining region 3 within the T-cell receptor provides critical insights into the composition and functional capacity of circulating T-cell populations. Prior to this investigation, the specific repertoire characteristics of the T-cell receptor alpha-chain and beta-chain across individuals with varying hepatitis B infection and vaccination statuses remained incompletely understood. To systematically evaluate these immune features, researchers employed high-throughput sequencing to profile the alpha-chain and beta-chain complementarity-determining region 3 repertoires within peripheral blood mononuclear cells. The study cohort comprised six inoculation-positive responders to hepatitis B vaccination, six individuals diagnosed with chronic hepatitis B, and five healthy donors. The research team systematically compared the frequency, diversity, sequence similarity, and variable and joining segment usage across the three examined groups. Sequence diversity comparisons demonstrated that the chronic hepatitis B group harbored significantly fewer unique alpha-chain and beta-chain complementarity-determining region 3 sequences than both the inoculation-positive responder group and the healthy donor group. Repertoire overlap analysis revealed marked differences in segment utilization among the study cohorts. The BUB overlap index for alpha-chain variable segments was significantly higher in inoculation-positive responders than in individuals with chronic hepatitis B (P = 0.0073) and healthy donors (P = 0.0317). For beta-chain variable segments, a significantly higher BUB index emerged specifically between inoculation-positive responders and chronic hepatitis B patients (P = 0.0002). Furthermore, identical alpha-chain complementarity-determining region 3 sequences were preferentially shared among individuals within each respective group, whereas beta-chain joining segment usage remained relatively stable across all three cohorts. The investigators concluded that circulating T cells display distinct alpha-beta complementarity-determining region 3 repertoire profiles in inoculation-positive responders and chronic hepatitis B patients. These observed signatures delineate immune differences linked to hepatitis B vaccination responsiveness and chronic disease state, which may help enhance understanding of protective vaccine-induced immunity and inform future investigations into alpha- and beta-chain strategies for hepatitis B virus diagnosis and prevention. supplementary_news.content: HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER Friday, November 13, 2026 No Result View All Result Login HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Home NEWS Science News Health Distinct proteomic patterns link hepatitis B treatments to HBsAg decline by November 10, 2026 in Health Reading Time: 3 mins read 0 Distinct proteomic patterns link hepatitis B treatments to HBsAg decline Share on FacebookShare on TwitterShare on LinkedinShare on RedditShare on Telegram Researchers have identified distinct longitudinal plasma proteomic trajectories associated with two different immunomodulatory therapies for chronic hepatitis B, suggesting that specific protein changes may correlate with favorable treatment responses. The study, published in Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology, examined how pegylated interferon-alpha (PEG-IFNα) and PD-1 blockade alter the circulating inflammatory proteome in patients whose viral replication is already suppressed by nucleos(t)ide analogues. By profiling plasma samples over a 24-week period, the team found that while both therapies induce immune remodeling, the breadth and timing of these changes differ significantly between the two treatment modalities. The investigation focused on 25 patients with chronic hepatitis B who were receiving either PD-1 blockade or PEG-IFNα therapy. The cohort was divided into two groups: ten patients received PD-1 blockade, and fifteen patients received PEG-IFNα. All participants were nucleos(t)ide analogue-suppressed. Plasma samples were collected at three distinct time points: baseline, week 12, and week 24, providing a longitudinal view of how the proteome evolved in response to each therapy. The researchers performed longitudinal plasma proteomic profiling using the Olink Target 96 Inflammation panel. Of the proteins measured, seventy-seven passed the quality-control criteria and were included in the final analysis. The study employed linear mixed-effects models to analyze longitudinal protein changes. The primary results indicated that PEG-IFNα induced substantially broader longitudinal proteomic remodeling compared to PD-1 blockade. Most of the significant protein changes in the PEG-IFNα group occurred within the first 12 weeks of treatment. In contrast, the PD-1 blockade group showed a more limited range of proteomic shifts. Treatment-by-time analyses revealed distinct trajectories for the two therapies, highlighting differential changes in several key inflammatory markers, including IL-18R1, TNF, CX3CL1, CXCL9, and CXCL10. The researchers also evaluated the association between these proteomic changes and clinical response, defined as a decline in hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) of at least one log10 IU/mL by week 24. Using responder–non-responder comparisons and Spearman’s rank correlation, the team identified treatment-specific patterns linked to this favorable decline. In the PD-1 blockade cohort, IL-10 emerged as the leading exploratory signal associated with HBsAg decline. In the PEG-IFNα cohort, IL-12B, CDCP1, and FGF-21 were more prominent in the response-associated analyses. However, the study emphasizes that these response-related associations did not remain significant after false discovery rate correction. Consequently, the authors classified these findings as exploratory rather than definitive biomarkers. The findings support the potential value of longitudinal proteomics for mechanistic and biomarker studies of HBV functional-cure strategies. By demonstrating that favorable HBsAg decline is accompanied by treatment-specific rather than universal proteomic signatures, the research highlights the potential value of tracking dynamic immune changes over time. Limitations of the study include the relatively small sample size, with only ten patients in the PD-1 blockade group and fifteen in the PEG-IFNα group. Virion Therapeutics Reports Progress Towards HBV Functional Cure with Continued HBsAg Declines in All Patients and No Viral Rebound Two Plus Years Following a VRON-0200 Prime Dose, at AASLD’s The Liver Meeting® 2026 Business Wire Mon, November 9, 2026 at 11:30 AM CST 5 min read Highlights from the Data Presentation VRON-0200 was safe and well tolerated, with no serious treatment-related adverse events, treatment discontinuations, or treatment-related clinical laboratory abnormalities reported During long-term follow up (LTFU), up to 2+ years following a VRON-0200 prime dose: No patients (0%; 0/26) experienced HBsAg rebound, with durable and deepening HBsAg declines observed in all patients (100%; 26/26) HBsAg mean annualized declines were 5.6-fold greater than historical rates observed in patients receiving NUC-only therapy 14 (54%) and 6 (23%) patients had a >0.5 log10 IU/mL and >1.7 log10 IU/mL decline from Day 1, respectively, with 8 patients (31%) having HBsAg levels <10 IU/mL (3 with HBsAg loss) A single VRON-0200 dose combines ease of administration, a favorable safety profile, and durable anti-HBV activity, supporting its potential as an interferon-sparing immune modulator for HBV Functional Cure strategies, alone, or in combination treatments PHILADELPHIA, November 09, 2026--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Virion Therapeutics, LLC, a clinical-stage biotechnology company, developing novel T cell-based immunotherapies that utilize checkpoint modifiers, today announced at AASLD's The Liver Meeting®, in Denver, CO, that an intramuscular prime dose of VRON-0200 alone, its novel, first-in-class, immunotherapy for HBV Functional Cure, induced anti-HBV activity with continued HBsAg declines, without rebound, up to 2+ years post dosing, in all chronically HBV-infected treated patients. These data, presented as a late breaking oral presentation, by Dr. Grace Wong, M.D., from the Chinese University of Hong Kong, also highlighted VRON-0200's favorable safety and tolerability profile, and viral biomarker data, through Day 360. Professor Grace Wong, M.D., from the Chinese University of Hong Kong, one of the study investigators, commented: "What stands out from these VRON-0200 data is that no HBsAg rebound was observed in any patient, and we have observed continued declines in HBsAg levels in all patients during long-term follow-up. New antivirals being developed for HBV Functional Cure are changing the treatment landscape and providing new options for our patients with chronic hepatitis B virus infection. However, to-date, most patients who lose HBsAg during treatment will rebound following treatment discontinuation. Restoring a patient's own immune responses against the virus with immune modulators and/or therapeutic vaccines is now considered an important strategy to help prevent rebound and improve treatment responses. These long-term VRON-0200 follow up data suggest that it has potential as a safe, easy to administer interferon-sparing immune modulator to address this issue." Story Continues "Immune modulators and therapeutic vaccines have an important role in improving HBV Functional Cure responses. "What is remarkable is that not only was there no HBsAg rebound after 2+ years, but the addition of a prime VRON-0200 dose to suppressive antiviral therapy also resulted in a rate of HBsAg decline that was 5.6 times greater than the historical rate observed in patients on antiviral therapy alone," said Dr. Sue Currie, Chief Operating Officer of Virion Therapeutics. "Its safety, ease of use, and durable anti-HBV activity provide the rationale for evaluating VRON-0200 in a broader range of HBV-infected patients; our SPARK-B Phase 2B study will evaluate off-treatment Functional Cure following nucleos(t)ide discontinuation and will include patients with baseline HBsAg levels up to 3,000 IU/mL. We are excited to advance the VRON-0200 program with the goal of improving Functional Cure rates for the almost 260 million people living with chronic HBV worldwide." Professor Ed Gane, M.D., from the University of Auckland, and one of the study investigators, noted: "The development of new HBV treatments that could produce durable loss of HBV DNA and HBsAg after a finite course of treatment has eluded the field for decades. Finally, we are seeing novel therapies, such as bepirovirsen, that will provide finite treatment options for some of our chronically HBV-infected patients. VRON-0200, with its ability to restore broad and durable anti-HBV immune responses, could become the key component of future combination regimens to both improve the rate of functional cure and also increase the size of the eligible patient population, simply through the addition of a single, well tolerated intramuscular injection. I look forward to continuing to follow VRON-0200's progress as it advances into later stage clinical trials." The presentation is available for download at www.VirionTx.com and more details of this study can be found at ClinicalTrials.gov (Identifier: NCT06070051). About Chronic Hepatitis B Despite a preventative vaccine, cases of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) continue to rise, with an estimated 254 million persons infected worldwide and 1.1 million deaths per year from HBV-related liver complications. Chronic HBV remains a global health issue with a high unmet medical need since there is no cure available. The current standard of care requires lifelong antiviral therapy to maintain control of the virus. Current and investigational HBV Functional Cure treatments have been limited by their inability to restore a patient's own immune responses against the virus. As a result, once treatment is discontinued, and the antiviral agents are no longer present, viral rebound typically occurs. As a result, immune modulators are now considered necessary for future cure treatment strategies. About VRON-0200 VRON-0200 is an investigational therapeutic immunotherapy designed with the goal of providing a functional cure for chronic HBV infection. Clinical data from an ongoing Phase 1b trial have shown VRON-0200 to be safe and well tolerated, and, when given as a single intramuscular dose, was immunogenic, and able to "Spark" anti-HBV activity in chronically HBV-infected patients on nucleos(t)ide therapy alone, and, also, when given with combination antiviral therapies. These results suggest the potential of VRON-0200 to be a key backbone immune modulator for HBV functional cure treatments. About Virion Therapeutics (Virion) Virion Therapeutics, LLC is a clinical-stage company developing novel immunotherapies that utilize proprietary checkpoint modifiers to enhance/restore, broaden, and elicit sustained immune responses, with the goal to cure cancer and chronic infectious diseases. Virion's pipeline now includes its lead VRON-0200 clinical program, and several additional IND-enabling programs, such as its VRON-0300 oncology program for advanced solid tumors, leveraging its proprietary platform technologies. To learn more, visit www.VirionTx.com View source version on businesswire.com: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261109040131/en/ Contacts Virion Therapeutics, LLC, Dr. Sue Currie, Chief Operating Officer scurrie@viriontx.com 1-800-841-9303 Terms and Privacy Policy Privacy Dashboard More Info Recommended Stories

supplementary_news.content: HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER Friday, November 13, 2026 No Result View All Result Login HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Home NEWS Science News Health CatBoost Model Integrates ctDNA Methylation to Detect Liver Cancer in HBV by November 12, 2026 in Health Reading Time: 3 mins read 0 CatBoost Model Integrates ctDNA Methylation to Detect Liver Cancer in HBV Share on FacebookShare on TwitterShare on LinkedinShare on RedditShare on Telegram An interpretable machine learning model integrating circulating tumor DNA methylation readouts with clinical features demonstrated high diagnostic performance in identifying hepatocellular carcinoma among hepatitis B virus-infected patients with intrahepatic nodules, according to study results published in BMC Gastroenterology. In an internal validation cohort, the top-performing CatBoost algorithm distinguished hepatocellular carcinoma from non-cancerous nodules with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.903. Distinguishing hepatocellular carcinoma from non-hepatocellular carcinoma nodules remains challenging in patients diagnosed with hepatitis B virus infection. To address this diagnostic setting, researchers evaluated ten machine learning algorithms using baseline clinical variables, laboratory indicators, and circulating tumor DNA methylation markers to construct an interpretable framework for individualized risk assessment following nodule detection. Discover more Bioengineering consulting services Health health The study cohort included 586 patients, with 217 adjudicated hepatocellular carcinoma outcomes. The researchers retained an existing partition of 411 patients in the training set and 175 patients in the internal validation set. Ten candidate algorithms underwent nested stratified cross-validation with ten outer folds and five inner folds using regularized candidate settings and a one-standard-error selection rule, with model selection and classification thresholds established solely on training data. Discover more Track Biotech Tour Colleges Donate to Research Find Study Aids Feature selection conducted with Boruta and LASSO retained eleven baseline predictors: patient age, presence of cirrhosis, maximum intrahepatic nodule diameter, alpha-fetoprotein, lens culinaris agglutinin-reactive alpha-fetoprotein percentage, and des-gamma-carboxy prothrombin. The remaining retained variables included albumin-bilirubin grade, aspartate aminotransferase, neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio, and two circulating tumor DNA methylation markers, HIST1H3G/ACTB and OTX1/ACTB. Among all evaluated algorithms, the frozen CatBoost model achieved the highest diagnostic metrics on the 175-patient internal validation set. In addition to an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.903, the model demonstrated a sensitivity of 0.800, a specificity of 0.818, an overall accuracy of 0.811, a positive predictive value of 0.722, a negative predictive value of 0.874, an F1 score of 0.759, and a Youden index of 0.618. To ensure interpretability, the investigators performed Shapley Additive Explanations analysis on the CatBoost model. This technique quantified and visualized the individual contribution of each clinical parameter, laboratory indicator, and methylation readout toward model predictions, clarifying the influence of specific features on estimated malignancy probabilities. While the integrated CatBoost model showed potential as an auxiliary tool for individualized assessment of cancer likelihood following nodule detection, the authors noted important study limitations. In particular, the reliance on historically derived feature selection and the reuse of the internal validation partition may limit the robustness of the reported validation results. supplementary_news.content: 1990—2021年全球乙型肝炎病毒相关疾病年龄别负担特征、驱动因素量化及至2050年的趋势预测 《Tropical Medicine and Health》:Global age-specific burden of HBV-related diseases, 1990–2021, with projections to 2050 【字体: 大 中 小 】 时间:2026年11月10日 来源:Tropical Medicine and Health 3.9 为了促进科学的传播,生物通采集了这篇文章 订阅BioHot点这里解锁原文链接推送! “畅读会员”点此登录查看原文链接 Research Open access 背景:普及儿童免疫接种已使年轻人群中乙型肝炎病毒(HBV,hepatitis B virus)相关疾病的疾病负担有所下降,但人口老龄化正在增加老年人群的相关疾病负担。本研究评估了1990—2021年全球HBV相关疾病的年龄别趋势,量化了驱动因素,并对至2050年的疾病负担进行预测,以期为优化预防策略提供依据。 方法:研究人员利用2021年全球疾病负担研究(Global Burden of Disease 2021,GBD 2021)数据,分析了1990—2021年间HBV相关疾病的发病率、患病率、死亡及伤残调整生命年(disability-adjusted life-years,DALYs)趋势。研究人员按年龄组(<20岁、20—54岁、≥55岁)对分析结果进行分层,采用Das Gupta分解法定量评估疾病负担变化的驱动因素,并按社会人口学指数(socio-demographic index,SDI)描述地理分布格局。研究人员应用贝叶斯年龄-时期-队列(Bayesian age-period-cohort,BAPC)建模对至2050年的疾病负担进行预测。 结果:1990年至2021年,全球HBV相关疾病年龄标化发病率、患病率、死亡率及DALY率均下降,而死亡与DALY的绝对数量增加。年龄分层分析显示,<20岁人群的所有疾病负担指标均急剧、一致下降;20—54岁人群及更显著的是≥55岁人群的降幅较为温和且病例数量增加。分解分析表明,流行病学改善驱动了年轻人群疾病负担的下降,而人口增长与老龄化抵消了老年人群中的这些获益。地理分布上,最高疾病负担仍集中于撒哈拉以南非洲和东南亚,而高SDI地区维持在最低水平。相对变化显示全球<20岁人群发病率降幅显著,而老年人群降幅较小。预测提示,尽管总体率将持续下降,≥55岁人群的绝对疾病负担将持续上升至2050年。 结论:尽管HBV相关疾病负担在年轻人群中持续下降,人口增长与老龄化正重塑全球HBV疾病负担格局,使其向≥55岁人群转移,凸显了针对性预防与管理策略的必要性。 一、研究背景与问题提出 欢迎领取《类器官应用方案 3D之旅》 领 取 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV,hepatitis B virus)感染仍是全球重大公共卫生挑战,其健康影响远超急性感染,还包括肝硬化和肝细胞癌等严重长期结局。随着预防控制策略推进与人口结构变化,HBV相关疾病流行病学已发生深刻转变:普及儿童免疫接种改变了年轻一代疾病趋势,而快速人口老龄化则形成了截然不同的疾病负担路径。既往研究多聚焦总体时间趋势、区域差异或疾病构成的特定组分,且年龄特异性模式、分解分析与年龄-时期-队列效应等分析视角常被单独考察,未在统一框架内整合评估;既往感染队列老化所致的老年人群绝对疾病负担上升趋势尚不明确。理解HBV相关疾病负担的年龄别转变对未来预防与管理策略制定至关重要。 二、研究开展概况 研究人员基于GBD 2021数据(覆盖204个国家和地区1990—2021年),将年龄别负担评估、基于社会人口学指数(socio-demographic index,SDI)的区域比较、Das Gupta分解与贝叶斯年龄-时期-队列(Bayesian age-period-cohort,BAPC)预测整合于单一分析框架,量化了流行病学变化、人口老龄化与人口增长对疾病负担变化的贡献,并预测年龄别轨迹至2050年。核心结论为:全球HBV相关疾病负担的年龄别分化日益显著,人口增长与老龄化正推动疾病负担向≥55岁人群转移。 关键方法概括:研究数据源自GBD 2021数据库(204个国家和地区1990—2021年),以整合急性乙型肝炎、慢性乙型肝炎(含乙肝相关肝硬化)和乙肝相关肝癌的HBV总负担为结局指标,采用发病率、患病率、死亡及DALYs计数和年龄标化率评估负担;运用Das Gupta分解法将绝对变化拆分为流行病学率、年龄结构与人口规模三类效应;应用R软件BAPC包构建年龄-时期-队列模型,以1990—2011年数据拟合、2012—2021年数据回溯验证并以平均绝对百分比误差(mean absolute percentage error,MAPE)评估预测性能,同时设定≥55、≥60、≥65岁三种老年界点开展敏感性分析。 三、研究结果 (一)1990—2021年全球HBV相关疾病年龄别负担:2021年全球HBV相关疾病发病6851万例,年龄标化发病率848.62/10万,较1990年下降41.61%;患病2.9123亿例,标化患病率3583.57/10万,下降39.05%;死亡64.918万例,标化死亡率7.57/10万,下降37.88%;DALYs达2147万,标化率252.48/10万,下降39.36%。年龄分层显示<20岁组所有指标一致下降;20—54岁与≥55岁组绝对负担轻微上升而率仅温和下降。疾病谱方面,急性乙型肝炎集中于<20岁组,HBV相关肝硬化DALY计数在20—54岁组最高,≥55岁组HBV相关肝癌DALY计数增幅最大且DALY率持续最高。 (二)全球HBV相关疾病负担变化的驱动因素:总体人群中流行病学率下降是各负担指标下降的主要贡献者(如发病例数变化中流行病学率贡献369.46%的下降,人口增长抵消270.62%,年龄结构仅贡献1.16%);年龄分层显示流行病学率效应在<20岁组最显著,而20—54岁及≥55岁组中年龄结构与人口规模的贡献常超过流行病学率改善的减少量,≥55岁组死亡中人口老龄化与人口增长分别贡献121.31%和113.59%,大幅抵消流行病学改善134.91%的下降。敏感性分析证实界点为≥55、≥60或≥65岁时结论一致。 (三)2021年全球HBV相关疾病负担的地理分布:最高负担集中于撒哈拉以南非洲和东南亚部分地区,最低年龄标化率见于西欧、北美和大洋洲等高SDI地区;<20岁组全球负担低,20—54岁组为发病与患病主要人群,≥55岁组死亡和DALY率显著更高。各年龄组地理分布相似且集中于低、中SDI地区,随年龄增长负担由以发病、患病为主转向以死亡、DALY为主。 (四)1990—2021年全球HBV相关疾病负担的地理变化趋势:全球标化发病与患病率普遍下降,发病降幅最大地区为波兰、意大利和中国台湾省,患病降幅最大地区为波兰、沙特阿拉伯和中国台湾省,丹麦、匈牙利和英国降幅最小。年龄分层呈地理异质性:<20岁组几乎所有地区各率值下降超25%,部分地区超75%;20—54岁组俄罗斯联邦和乌克兰死亡与DALY率升幅超100%;≥55岁组英国、俄罗斯联邦及部分欧洲国家死亡和DALY率上升。 (五)按年龄组划分的SDI区域HBV相关疾病负担的相对变化:<20岁组所有SDI区域绝对负担均下降,中高SDI区域降幅最大;20—54岁组低SDI区域绝对负担增幅最大、高SDI区域降幅最大;≥55岁组所有SDI区域绝对负担均上升,中低SDI区域增长最陡。率值在所有年龄组和SDI区域均下降,<20岁组在中高SDI区域降幅最大,20—54岁和≥55岁组在中或更高SDI区域降幅最大。 (六)2022—2050年全球HBV相关疾病负担的年龄组预测:全年龄绝对负担预计持续下降,但年龄别模式差异显著,<20岁和20—54岁组绝对负担下降,≥55岁组上升(如≥55岁组发病例数预计从2030年1250万增至2050年1578万,而<20岁组从722万降至311万)。所有年龄组率值预计下降,<20岁组降幅最大(发病率由2022年394.30/10万降至2050年127.15/10万),≥55岁组降幅最小(703.01降至583.45/10万)。回溯检验显示多数MAPE值低于10%,敏感性分析结果与主分析一致。 四、讨论部分总结 讨论指出,各年龄组间的鲜明分歧是最关键发现,解释了总体率下降与总人群绝对负担上升并存的悖论。<20岁组负担急剧一致下降,流行病学率改善为主导驱动,与疫苗接种在健康婴儿、儿童和青少年中诱导的超过95%血清保护率一致;而老年人疫苗血清保护率降至60%—70%且多出生于普遍接种之前,形成独特流行病学模式。≥55岁组所有绝对指标显著上升(发病增74.10%、患病增87.38%、死亡增42.77%、DALYs增35.86%),人口增长与老龄化联合效应远超流行病学率改善的减少量,人口压力主导了老年人群流行病学格局;这些发现应解释为人群水平模式而非个体纵向转变。地理差异与年龄别异质性并存,部分欧洲区域死亡与DALY率上升超100%,反映预防控制收益分配不均。世界卫生组织(World Health Organization,WHO)2030年消除病毒性肝炎的目标面临疾病负担老龄化的重大人口学挑战。政策启示包括:维持青少年疫苗接种进展(及时接种首针并补种);对≥55岁人群扩大筛查、强化诊断并促进抗病毒治疗;针对不同SDI区域实施差异化策略。局限性包括BAPC模型依赖历史数据、≥55岁组预测不确定性区间(uncertainty intervals,UIs)较宽、未量化疫苗接种与抗病毒治疗贡献及未详察国家内部差异。 五、研究结论部分翻译 总之,尽管全球HBV相关疾病负担的年龄标化率(age-standardized rates,ASRs)已下降,≥55岁人群绝对负担却增加,人口增长和老龄化在很大程度上促成了这一转变,抵消了有利流行病学变化带来的减少。区域差异依然显著,低、中SDI地区承担最大负担。预测表明这种年龄相关转变可能持续,凸显实现WHO定义的2030年肝炎消除目标仍面临持续挑战。应对挑战需加强针对性筛查、改善老年人群抗病毒治疗可及性,并实施区域特异性的预防控制策略。 一、研究背景与问题提出乙型肝炎病毒(HBV,hepatitis B virus)感染仍是全球重大公共卫生挑战,其健康影响远超急性感染,还包括肝硬化和肝细胞癌等严重长期结局。随着预防控制策略推进与人口结构变化,HBV相关疾病流行病学已发生深刻转变:普及儿童免疫接种改变了年轻一代疾病趋势,而快速人口老龄化则形成了截然不同的疾病负担路径。既往研究多聚焦总体时间趋势、区域差异或疾病构成的特定组分,且年龄特异性模式、分解分析与年龄-时期-队列效应等分析视角常被单独考察,未在统一框架内整合评估;既往感染队列老化所致的老年人群绝对疾病负担上升趋势尚不明确。理解HBV相关疾病负担的年龄别转变对未来预防与管理策略制定至关重要。二、研究开展概况研究人员基于GBD 2021数据(覆盖204个国家和地区1990—2021年),将年龄别负担评估、基于社会人口学指数(socio-demographic index,SDI)的区域比较、Das Gupta分解与贝叶斯年龄-时期-队列(Bayesian age-period-cohort,BAPC)预测整合于单一分析框架,量化了流行病学变化、人口老龄化与人口增长对疾病负担变化的贡献,并预测年龄别轨迹至2050年。核心结论为:全球HBV相关疾病负担的年龄别分化日益显著,人口增长与老龄化正推动疾病负担向≥55岁人群转移。关键方法概括:研究数据源自GBD 2021数据库(204个国家和地区1990—2021年),以整合急性乙型肝炎、慢性乙型肝炎(含乙肝相关肝硬化)和乙肝相关肝癌的HBV总负担为结局指标,采用发病率、患病率、死亡及DALYs计数和年龄标化率评估负担;运用Das Gupta分解法将绝对变化拆分为流行病学率、年龄结构与人口规模三类效应;应用R软件BAPC包构建年龄-时期-队列模型,以1990—2011年数据拟合、2012—2021年数据回溯验证并以平均绝对百分比误差(mean absolute percentage error,MAPE)评估预测性能,同时设定≥55、≥60、≥65岁三种老年界点开展敏感性分析。三、研究结果(一)1990—2021年全球HBV相关疾病年龄别负担:2021年全球HBV相关疾病发病6851万例,年龄标化发病率848.62/10万,较1990年下降41.61%;患病2.9123亿例,标化患病率3583.57/10万,下降39.05%;死亡64.918万例,标化死亡率7.57/10万,下降37.88%;DALYs达2147万,标化率252.48/10万,下降39.36%。年龄分层显示<20岁组所有指标一致下降;20—54岁与≥55岁组绝对负担轻微上升而率仅温和下降。疾病谱方面,急性乙型肝炎集中于<20岁组,HBV相关肝硬化DALY计数在20—54岁组最高,≥55岁组HBV相关肝癌DALY计数增幅最大且DALY率持续最高。(二)全球HBV相关疾病负担变化的驱动因素:总体人群中流行病学率下降是各负担指标下降的主要贡献者(如发病例数变化中流行病学率贡献369.46%的下降,人口增长抵消270.62%,年龄结构仅贡献1.16%);年龄分层显示流行病学率效应在<20岁组最显著,而20—54岁及≥55岁组中年龄结构与人口规模的贡献常超过流行病学率改善的减少量,≥55岁组死亡中人口老龄化与人口增长分别贡献121.31%和113.59%,大幅抵消流行病学改善134.91%的下降。敏感性分析证实界点为≥55、≥60或≥65岁时结论一致。(三)2021年全球HBV相关疾病负担的地理分布:最高负担集中于撒哈拉以南非洲和东南亚部分地区,最低年龄标化率见于西欧、北美和大洋洲等高SDI地区;<20岁组全球负担低,20—54岁组为发病与患病主要人群,≥55岁组死亡和DALY率显著更高。各年龄组地理分布相似且集中于低、中SDI地区,随年龄增长负担由以发病、患病为主转向以死亡、DALY为主。(四)1990—2021年全球HBV相关疾病负担的地理变化趋势:全球标化发病与患病率普遍下降,发病降幅最大地区为波兰、意大利和中国台湾省,患病降幅最大地区为波兰、沙特阿拉伯和中国台湾省,丹麦、匈牙利和英国降幅最小。年龄分层呈地理异质性:<20岁组几乎所有地区各率值下降超25%,部分地区超75%;20—54岁组俄罗斯联邦和乌克兰死亡与DALY率升幅超100%;≥55岁组英国、俄罗斯联邦及部分欧洲国家死亡和DALY率上升。(五)按年龄组划分的SDI区域HBV相关疾病负担的相对变化:<20岁组所有SDI区域绝对负担均下降,中高SDI区域降幅最大;20—54岁组低SDI区域绝对负担增幅最大、高SDI区域降幅最大;≥55岁组所有SDI区域绝对负担均上升,中低SDI区域增长最陡。率值在所有年龄组和SDI区域均下降,<20岁组在中高SDI区域降幅最大,20—54岁和≥55岁组在中或更高SDI区域降幅最大。(六)2022—2050年全球HBV相关疾病负担的年龄组预测:全年龄绝对负担预计持续下降,但年龄别模式差异显著,<20岁和20—54岁组绝对负担下降,≥55岁组上升(如≥55岁组发病例数预计从2030年1250万增至2050年1578万,而<20岁组从722万降至311万)。所有年龄组率值预计下降,<20岁组降幅最大(发病率由2022年394.30/10万降至2050年127.15/10万),≥55岁组降幅最小(703.01降至583.45/10万)。回溯检验显示多数MAPE值低于10%,敏感性分析结果与主分析一致。四、讨论部分总结讨论指出,各年龄组间的鲜明分歧是最关键发现,解释了总体率下降与总人群绝对负担上升并存的悖论。<20岁组负担急剧一致下降,流行病学率改善为主导驱动,与疫苗接种在健康婴儿、儿童和青少年中诱导的超过95%血清保护率一致;而老年人疫苗血清保护率降至60%—70%且多出生于普遍接种之前,形成独特流行病学模式。≥55岁组所有绝对指标显著上升(发病增74.10%、患病增87.38%、死亡增42.77%、DALYs增35.86%),人口增长与老龄化联合效应远超流行病学率改善的减少量,人口压力主导了老年人群流行病学格局;这些发现应解释为人群水平模式而非个体纵向转变。地理差异与年龄别异质性并存,部分欧洲区域死亡与DALY率上升超100%,反映预防控制收益分配不均。世界卫生组织(World Health Organization,WHO)2030年消除病毒性肝炎的目标面临疾病负担老龄化的重大人口学挑战。政策启示包括:维持青少年疫苗接种进展(及时接种首针并补种);对≥55岁人群扩大筛查、强化诊断并促进抗病毒治疗;针对不同SDI区域实施差异化策略。局限性包括BAPC模型依赖历史数据、≥55岁组预测不确定性区间(uncertainty intervals,UIs)较宽、未量化疫苗接种与抗病毒治疗贡献及未详察国家内部差异。五、研究结论部分翻译总之,尽管全球HBV相关疾病负担的年龄标化率(age-standardized rates,ASRs)已下降,≥55岁人群绝对负担却增加,人口增长和老龄化在很大程度上促成了这一转变,抵消了有利流行病学变化带来的减少。区域差异依然显著,低、中SDI地区承担最大负担。预测表明这种年龄相关转变可能持续,凸显实现WHO定义的2030年肝炎消除目标仍面临持续挑战。应对挑战需加强针对性筛查、改善老年人群抗病毒治疗可及性,并实施区域特异性的预防控制策略。 打赏 展开全文 开通VIP supplementary_news.excerpt: 近日,侯金林教授在接受第一财经独家专访时表示,贝普若韦生的III期临床研究显示,中国慢性乙肝患者群体展现出较好的功能性治愈潜力,部分研究结果优于全球整体水平。这一进展不仅为乙肝功能性治愈带来了新的科学依据,也进一步凸显了中国患者在全球乙肝创新研究中的重要价值。与此同时,如何进一步加强慢性乙肝患者筛查、推动乙肝定量检测技术普及,以及完善规范化诊疗和长期管理体系,仍是推动乙肝防治水平持续提升的重要课题。
